faq.a1: Kaore. Ko DeHub i dehub.io he papaaho pāpori puna tuwhera motuhake. Ko te tomokanga akonga DeHUB a DePaul University, ko te DEHub a Rowan me te taupānga whakauru tatau deHUB Access he hua kore e pa ana ki te tohatoha i te ingoa.
faq.a2: Ae. DeHub he free ki te tiki i Google Play me te App Store, a free ki te whakamahi i roto i te pūtirotiro i dehub.io.
faq.a3: Android waea mā Google Play ranei te tiki tika APK, iPhone mā te App Store, me tetahi papamahi hou ranei pūtirotiro pūkoro i dehub.io.
faq.a4: Ae. Ko te hanga Android hou rawa atu kua whakaputaina e DeHub hei tango APK tika ki dehub.io/apk, mō Android 8 me teitei ake.
faq.a5: Tukuna ki tētahi whāngai wā-tūturu, haere ora, mātakitaki rānei i ngā rerenga ora, tukuna he karere ki ngā hoa me te whakamunatanga mutunga-ki-te-mutunga, uru atu ki ngā hapori me te whakahaere i a rātou, pupuri i ngā tohu ki tētahi pēke maha-mekameka kua hangaia ki roto, me te whiwhi utu mō te mātakitaki.

faq.a1: Ae. He koreutu a DeHub ki te whakauru me te kore utu ki te tuku, a he kowhiringa te hanga i tetahi awa i runga i te raka. Ka utua te kawemai i te hongere, ka whakaatuhia tona utu i mua i to utu.
faq.a2: E kore. Kia mau ki te rere i te wahi e to koutou hunga whakarongo i tenei ra, me te hanga i runga i DeHub i te taha o reira. Cross-post i te kaiwaiata DeHub na nga papa katoa kua whakamahia e koe nga tohu ki te hunga whakarongo e whai ake nei koe.
faq.a3: Ae. tīpako OBS ka haere koe ora, a DeHub hoatu ki a koutou he kī rere tonu mo OBS, Streamlabs ranei tetahi encoder RTMP. Ka taea hoki e koe te haere ora tika i tō waea, i tō pūtirotiro, i tētahi kāri hopu rānei.
faq.a4: Tirohia tohutohu me te tuku taonga i roto i to koutou awa, me te hunga e noho i runga i te blockchain i roto i DeHub tohu tika ki to koutou putea. Ka taea hoki e nga Uploads te kore utu, te utu i te tirohanga, te tohu ranei.
faq.a5: Whakatuwherahia te whārangi hononga ki te tiki i to hononga. Ko te tangata e uru ana ki a ia ka whakawhiwhia ki a koe, a ka whiwhi koe i te 20% o to raatau mahi me te 5% mai i nga tangata e tono ana ratou, ka utua i nga tohu DeHub.

streamPage.howToStart: Waitohu, whakatuwheratia te kaitito pou me te pato i te Haere ora — mai i tō kāmera, OBS, kāri hopu rānei.
streamPage.intro: Kawea mai tō hunga mātakitaki ora ki tētahi tūāpapa nāu ake. Haere ora mai i tō waea, tō pūtirotiro, OBS rānei, whiwhi pito i runga i te mekameka i a koe e rere ana, me te pupuri i te hunga mātakitaki i hangaia e koe. I hangaia a DeHub e te tīma i muri i a First Class Agency, te tari hoa TikTok LIVE whaimana tau tuatahi o te UK, me te neke atu i te 1,000 ngā kaiwhakaata ora.

reasons.body1: Ka tuku pito me ngā koha ngā mātakitaki i a koe e ora ana, me ngā hākoritanga koha kua whakarōpūhia me ngā karere pito e pānuitia ana i runga i te rere. Ka tau ngā pito i runga i te mekameka ki ngā tohu DeHub, ā, ka tau tika ki tō pēke kaua i te tapahia i te huarahi.
reasons.body2: Ko ō kaiwhaiwhai ehara i te rarangi i roto i te pātengi raraunga a tētahi atu. Ka taea te hanga i ngā rerenga me ngā tukunga ki runga i te mekameka ki tō pēke, he wā-tūturu te whāngai, ā, he pūtake tuwhera te waehere, nō reira kāore he tangata e tuhi anō i ngā ture i te huna.
reasons.body3: Ka utua koe e tō hono pōwhiri ki te 20% o te mahi a ia tangata e uru mai ana mā reira, me te 5% anō mai i ngā tāngata ka pōwhiritia e rātou, ka utua ki ngā tohu DeHub.
reasons.body4: Manaakitia ngā Atamira oro ora mō ngā pātai, ngā mahi tahi me ngā rōpū mātakitaki. Whakapuakina tētahi i mua i te wā me tētahi kāri ka taea e tō hunga mātakitaki te tiri, me te whakarongo anō ki ngā mea kua hopukina.
reasons.body5: Honoa ō atu pūkete i te kotahi o te wā me te whakaputa ki X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Farcaster me ētahi atu tūāpapa e waru mai i te kaitito DeHub. Puritia a TikTok hei pūkaha kitenga i a koe e hanga ana i tētahi hunga mātakitaki nāu ake.
reasons.body6: Kawemai i tētahi hongere YouTube katoa, tētahi kōtaha TikTok, Vimeo, SoundCloud rānei, i te puranga kotahi. Ka whakaaturia te utu tūturu ki ngā tohu DeHub i mua i tō utu.

accountConnect.body: Whakapāngia tō pūkete hei whakahaere i tō kōtaha, hei whakaputa pou me te hanga ihirangi mai i te kōrerorero. Ka pau ngā hononga i roto i te 24 hāora. Ka taea e koe te momotu i ngā wā katoa.

accountConnect.intro: Tirotirohia a DeHub i roto i te ChatGPT, honoa rānei tō ake pūkete hei whakahou i tō kōtaha, hei whakaputa pou me te whakamahi i te Creator Studio. Tāpirihia te https://dehub.io/mcp hei tūhono OAuth mō ngā mana whakahaere pūkete.
accountConnect.what: Tirotirohia ngā pou tūmatanui me ngā kōtaha. Mā te hononga pūkete OAuth, whakahaerehia tō kōtaha me tō tūmataiti, whakaputaina ngā pou me ngā tākupu, whāia ngā tāngata, pānuihia ngā whakamōhiotanga, tiakina ngā tohuwāhi me te hanga whakaahua, ataata, oro me ngā rawa 3D. Ka whakamahia e te hanga ngā ture utu o DeHub.
accountConnect.account: Kāore he pūkete e hiahiatia ana mō te tirotiro tūmatanui. Whakapāngia tō pūkete DeHub hei whakahaere i tō kōtaha me te hanga, te whakaputa ihirangi rānei.

Ko nga whakaahua e whakamahi ana i nga whakaahua kua tirohia; ko nga ataata e hiahia ana ki te whakaahua taupoki. Ko nga utu e noho ana i raro i te 500 nga tohu. Kaore he hau ki te kore e peita; ka taea e te tuhi te whakamahi i nga nama.

workspace.moderationHelp: Whakahohea te whakaaetanga whakahaere i te tuatahi. Me noho kē te pūkete hei kaihanga o te pāho ora, hei kaiwhakahaere kua tohua rānei. Ka hāngai tonu ngā aratau whakaae tuatahi me te hukihuki anake. Ka pau aunoa ngā wā whakatā.

Kāore e taea te muku ngā tirohanga, ngā whakamōhiotanga kua tukuna, ngā whakawhitinga kua waihangatia, ngā whakaahua kōtaha me ngā wā whakatā kua pau. Ka taea tonu te whakahoki mai ngā pānui huna mā ō rātou mana tirohanga.

careers.title: Mahi i DeHub
careers.subtitle: Honoa ki te rōpū e hanga ana i te anamata o ngā pāpāho pāpori whakamahana
careers.intro: E rapu ana mātou i ngā tāngata ngākaunui e hiahia ana ki te whai wāhi ki te ngaru pāpāho pāpori e haere mai ana — tērā e whakanui ana i ngā kaihanga me ngā hapori. Ko ngā tūranga katoa he mahi mamao katoa me ngā hāora mārire.
careers.bdmAbout: Hei kaiwhakahaere whanaketanga pakihi i DeHub, ko koe te kaha kawe o tā mātou rautaki hononga.
careers.bdmResp1: Kimi me te whakaū hononga rautaki me ngā kamupene Web2 me Web3 e hāngai ana ki te kaupapa o DeHub
careers.bdmResp2: Hanga me te whakahaere i te rārangi o ngā hononga, kaitautoko me ngā āheinga whakakotahi
careers.bdmResp3: Māngai i DeHub i ngā hui ahumahi, wānanga me ngā hui mariko
careers.bdmResp4: Kōrero mō ngā tikanga hononga, tauira tuari moni me ngā kirimana hokohoko tahi
careers.bdmResp5: Mahi tahi me ngā rōpū hua me ngā rōpū hokohoko ki te hanga kaupapa tahi me ngā whakakotahi
careers.whatWereLooking: He aha tā mātou e rapu ana
careers.bdmReq1: Wheako kua whakaūngia i te whanaketanga pakihi, hononga, hoko rānei i te ahumahi hangarau, kēmu, Web3 rānei
careers.bdmReq2: He whatunga kaha o nāianei i te wāhi crypto/Web3, ōhanga kaihanga rānei he painga nui
careers.bdmReq3: He pūkenga whakawhiti kōrero me kōrero pai rawa — ka taea e koe te whakaoti hokonga me te hanga hononga roa
careers.bdmReq4: He tangata e ārahi ana i a ia anō, e pai ana ki te mahi motuhake i te taiao mamao
careers.bdmReq5: He hiahia pono ki ngā whatunga pāpāho whakamahana, NFT, hangarau poraka rānei
careers.bdmComp: Ka tuku tēnei tūranga i te utu kōrero me te hanganga utu kōmihana OTE kāore e herea, e hono tika ana ki ngā hononga e kawea mai ana e koe.
careers.uncappedOTE: hanganga utu kōmihana OTE kāore e herea
careers.ambassadorAbout: Hei kaimāngai waitohu DeHub, ko koe te kanohi me te reo o te pūhara i tō hapori.
careers.ambassadorResp1: Hanga me te tuari ihirangi mana mō DeHub i ō hongere pāpāho pāpori whaiaro
careers.ambassadorResp2: Whai wāhi hohe ki te hapori DeHub i te taupānga — tuku pānui, tākupu me te whai wāhi ki ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi
careers.ambassadorResp3: Whai wāhi me te māngai i DeHub i ngā hui ā-tinana, hui me ngā wānanga i tō rohe
careers.ambassadorResp4: Kukume mai kaiwhakamahi hou me ngā kaihanga ki te pūhara mā tō whatunga whaiaro
careers.ambassadorResp5: Tuku urupare me ngā whakaaro mai i te hapori hei āwhina ki te hanga mahere hua
careers.ambassadorReq1: He noho hohe i ngā pāpāho pāpori me te whai wāhi mana
careers.ambassadorReq2: He ngākaunui ki te Web3, crypto, kēmu, ahurea kaihanga rānei
careers.ambassadorReq3: He pūkenga whakawhiti kōrero kaha me te kaha ki te whakamārama ariā uaua ki te ngāwari
careers.ambassadorReq4: He tangata e ārahi ana i a ia anō, ka taea te whakamahere me te whakatinana kaupapa motuhake
careers.ambassadorReq5: Ko te wheako o mua hei kaimāngai, kaiwhakaawe, kaiwhakahaere hapori rānei he painga
careers.ambassadorComp: Ka whiwhi ngā kaimāngai waitohu i te utu ā-marama kōrero, ka utua i ia wā.

dao.title: Te Putea a te DAO
dao.subtitle: Kotahi pēke, nā te hapori i tautoko, nā tōna pōtanga i whakapau
dao.contributeIntro: Tukua ngā tohu DeHub mai i tō putea ki te taonga. Ko ia tohu ka taapirihia e koe ka whakanui ake tō wāhanga o te puna, ā, ko tō wāhanga te taumaha o tō pooti ka whakatau te DAO ki te whakamahi.

dao.switchChain: Whakawhitihia to putea ki {{chains}}@ hei awhina.
dao.sentDesc: I tukua {{amount}} tohu ki te taonga i te {{chain}}. Ka whakahoutia tō wāhanga ka oti te raarangi poraka.
dao.sendAnyWallet: Ka taea e te tangata te tuku tohu DeHub ki konei mai i tētahi putea, whakawhiti rānei. Ko ngā whakawhiti i runga i te Base me te BNB ka tatauhia ki tō wāhanga.

dao.howItWorksTitle: Me pēhea te mahi o te mana
dao.howItWorksBody: Ko tō mana ko tō koha ka wehea ki ngā mea katoa i tukua ki te putea. Ka pānuitia tika mai i te mekameka, kāore e pau, ā, ka whakatau tō reo i te nui o te taumaha ina pōtanga te DAO mō te whakapau.

dao.votingPowerNote: E 7 nga ra te roa o te pooti. Ko te mana pooti ko te kohinga tohu a ia kaituku i te whakatuwheratanga o tenei tono. Me 10% te iti rawa o te hunga ka uru, me te whakaae kia nui ake i te paopao.

proof.title: Nō hea ēnei tau
proof.subtitle: Nā Cloudflare i ine, ehara nā tēnei whārangi
proof.query: Te uiui tika kei muri i te tūtohi
proof.openRaw: Te whakautu a Cloudflare kāore i pāngia
proof.edge: Ka haere ia tono ki dehub.io mā Cloudflare i mua i tōna taenga ki ā mātou tūmau. Ko ēnei tatauranga te whakahiatotanga a Cloudflare anō o taua waka — ko ngā tau ōrite e whakaatuhia ana e tā mātou papatohu. Ehara i te tuhinga i tō pūtirotiro e kohi ana, nō reira kāore he mea i tēnei whārangi e taea ai te whakanui, ā, kāore te ārai kaiwhaiwhai e whakarerekē ana.
proof.live: Ka pānui ora te whārangi i a rātou. Mā te uta i te /stats ka karangatia tā mātou pito, ka uiui atu ki te Analytics API a Cloudflare i taua wā tonu, ka penapena i te whakautu mō te 60 hēkona.
proof.limits: He aha tā tēnei e whakaatu ai, he aha tāna kāore: ka kite koe ka puta ngā tau mai i te whakahiatotanga a Cloudflare, ehara i tā mātou waehere taupānga, ā, ko te uiui i whakaputaina i konei ko te mea e rere ana. Ehara i te mea kāore he whakawhirinaki — kei a mātou te tohu API, ā, kāore a Cloudflare e tuku pānui tūmatanui mō ngā wetewete o tētahi rohe. Ko te tangata e whai rohe Cloudflare ana ka taea e ia te whakahaere i te uiui ōrite me te whakaū i tōna āhua.

definitions.title: He aha te tikanga o ēnei tau
definitions.visitors: — ngā wāhitau IP motuhake i kitea e Cloudflare i taua rā. E tata ana ki te tangata, engari ehara i te mea ōrite: ka tatauria kotahi te tari kei runga i te hononga kotahi, ā, ka tatauria rua te waea e huri ana i waenga i te wifi me te raraunga pūkoro.
definitions.pageViews: — ngā tono e whakarōpūtia ana e Cloudflare hei utanga whārangi, ehara i te whakaahua, tuhinga, karanga API rānei.
definitions.bots: — he tatauranga mata ēnei i te tapa, nō reira kei roto ngā kaikawe, ngā aroturuki wāhi mahi me ngā kiritaki tuhinga. Ka kite koe i a rātou i te wehewehenga pūtirotiro i runga ake nei, kei reira ngā tāurunga pēnā i "Curl" me "Kāore i te mōhiotia" he waka aunoa, ehara i te tangata. Hei tātari i ngā pūrehe me whai mahere Cloudflare utu kāore i a mātou, ā, ki te tangohia puku he whakatau tata ka iti ake te taea o ngā tau te tirotiro, kaua e nui ake.
definitions.total: — ka tāpiritia ngā tirohanga whārangi me ngā tono puta noa i te whānuitanga. Kāore ngā tatauranga manuhiri e tāpiritia ana ki te "tapeke manuhiri", nā te mea ko te tangata i konei i te Rāhina me te Rātū ka taua rua.
definitions.peak: — ko te tatauranga motuhake teitei rawa i tētahi wāhanga kotahi o te whānuitanga, mō te take ōrite: he tau e inea tūturutia ana e Cloudflare, ehara i te mea i hangaia mā te tāpiri i ngā tatauranga e taupatupatu ana.
definitions.resolutionTerm: Ka mutu ngā raraunga ā-haora i te 3 rā
definitions.resolution: — koinā te tepe a Cloudflare i tēnei mahere, ehara i te kōwhiringa: ka whakakāhoretia e ia ngā uiui ā-haora nui ake i te toru rā. He ā-haora ngā tirohanga 24 haora me te 3 rā; he ā-rā te 7 rā me te roa ake, ā, kāore he huarahi hei tā tūtohi ā-haora mō te wā katoa.
definitions.breakdown: — ka whai ēnei i te whānuitanga i tīpakohia e koe, engari ki ngā rā {{max}} anake ki muri, koirā te roa e puritia ai te wehewehenga ia rā. I ngā whānuitanga roa ake ka kapi te tūtohi i te wā nui ake i te rārangi whenua.
definitions.start: — ko te "wā katoa" te tikanga ko ia rā e puritia tonutia ana e Cloudflare, i tēnei rā ko ngā rā {{days}} mai i te {{date}}, te rā i neke ai a dehub.io ki Cloudflare. Kāore he raraunga tapa o mua hei whakaatu, ā, ka taka ngā rā tawhito i te wā e whakakoroheketia ana e Cloudflare.
definitions.estimated: — mai i te {{date}}, dehub.io kua tukuna ma te tūmau tuku kia taea ai e nga whatunga e kore e taea te tae tika ki Cloudflare te uta i te pae. Ka kite a Cloudflare i te nuinga o nga manuhiri hei wahitau kotahi o te relay, a ka hinga tona tatau motuhake. Mo aua ra, ko te mahere e whakaatu ana i nga tirohanga whaarangi kua oti te ine i te ōwehenga o nga manuhiri i ia whārangi o te {{days}} ra i mua ({{ratio}}%). Ko nga tirohanga me nga tono o nga whaarangi kei te whanganga tika tonu, a ko te tatau kore a Cloudflare kei roto i te whakautu raw e pa ana ki runga ake nei.

Mēnā kua pai ki a koe kia whakatupuranga mātou i ō kupu, tīkina te pouaka a mātou ka whakamahia pea i roto i ngā pōst, ngā ataata, i te paetukutuku rānei.

taxSplit.intro: I pūtea te moni whiwhi hītori i ngā mahi, i ngā hoko-hoki tohu me ngā utu mō ngā kaipupuri me ngā kaiwhakanoho. E whakaaturia ana ngā moni i roto i ngā tāra i te uara i ia rā utu. Whakatuwheratia ia wāhanga kia kite i ōna moni taketake me ia tauwhitinga.

jobs.seoTitle: Nga Mahi i DeHub — Whakatuwherahia nga Roles i Web3 Social Media
jobs.seoDescription: Hono ki te rōpū DeHub — tūnga tuwhera i roto i te whanaketanga pakihi, hokohoko me te ake.
jobs.heading: Nga mahi i DeHub
jobs.subheading: Hono ki te rōpū hanga i te heke mai o te pāpāho pāpori decentralised
jobs.intro: Kei te rapu mātou i ngā tāngata ngākau nui e hiahia ana kia uru ki te ngaru pāpāho pāpori e whai ake nei — tētahi e whai ana i ngā kaihanga me ngā hapori ki mua. Ko ngā tūranga katoa he mamao rawa me ngā haora ngāwari, kia whai wāhi ai koe ki te mahi mai i hea o te ao.
jobs.whatWereLookingFor: He aha ta tatou e rapu ana
jobs.tagBdmPay: Te utu whakawhitiwhiti + Te Komihana OTE
jobs.bdmAbout: Hei tetahi o a maatau Kaiwhakahaere Whakawhanaketanga Pakihi i DeHub, ka uru koe ki te kaha e peia ana i muri i ta maatau rautaki hononga. Ko tō misiona ko te tautuhi, te whakauru, me te whakaoti i ngā mahi ki ngā kamupene puta noa i te Web2 me te Web3 — mai i ngā taiwhanga kēmu me ngā papaa ihirangi ki ngā kaupapa poraka me ngā kawa DeFi. He tūranga utu-i-te-whāinga tēnei (On-Target Earnings) i runga i te komihana: ka kaha ake tō kaha, ka nui ake tō whiwhi. He māmā te tūranga, kawea mai ngā kamupene, ngā kaupapa, ngā hapori, me ngā kōtaha nui rānei ki DeHub, ā, ka utua koe. Ko te whakaaro, ko te nui ake o te mōhio ka nui ake te tipu ki tō tātou rauropi, ka nui ake te utu o ngā putea pōnus mō ngā kaupapa angitu. He porowhita tipu mutungakore tēnei me te kaha whiwhi mutungakore. Ko te kawe mai i ngā kaiwhakapāho ki te papaa ka whakatuwhera i ngā putea pōnus anō hoki me tētahi hanganga komihana rangatira i roto i te umanga — ka nui ake te uara e kawea ana e koe, ka nui ake tō whiwhi. Ahakoa te hunga kaore he wheako ka tono mai, mena ka tika te ngākau mō te tūranga.
jobs.bdmResp1: Te tautuhi me te haumaru o nga hononga rautaki me nga kamupene Web2 me Web3 e hono ana ki te misiona a DeHub
jobs.bdmResp2: Te hanga me te whakahaere i te paipa o nga hoa e whai ake nei, nga kaitautoko, me nga whai waahi whakauru
jobs.bdmResp3: Kaitohutohu DeHub i nga huihuinga umanga, huihuinga, me nga huihuinga mariko
jobs.bdmResp4: Nga tikanga hononga whakawhitiwhiti, nga tauira tohatoha moni, me nga kirimana hokohoko tahi
jobs.bdmResp5: Te mahi tahi me nga roopu hua me te hokohoko ki te whakawhanake i nga kaupapa tahi me nga whakauru
jobs.bdmWant1: Te wheako whai hua i roto i te whanaketanga pakihi, hononga, hoko ranei i roto i te hangarau, kēmu, Web3 ranei
jobs.bdmWant2: Ko te whatunga kaha o mua i roto i te crypto/Web3 ranei te waahi o te ohanga kaihanga he painga nui
jobs.bdmWant3: He pai nga pukenga whakawhitiwhiti korero me te whakawhitiwhiti korero — ka taea e koe te kati i nga kirimana me te hanga hononga pumau
jobs.bdmWant4: He pai, he pai hoki te mahi motuhake i roto i te taiao mamao tuatahi
jobs.bdmWant5: Te hiahia pono ki nga papaho pāpori decentralised, NFTs, hangarau blockchain ranei
jobs.bdmCompensation: Ka tukuna e tēnei tūranga he utu turanga ka taea te whiriwhiri me tētahi hanganga komihana OTE mutungakore e herea tika ana ki ngā hononga e kawea mai ana e koe. Ko te hunga tino pai ka whai kaha whiwhi mutungakore.
jobs.applyAsBdm: Whakamahia kia rite ki te BDM
jobs.otherSocialsPlaceholder: Tikanga, YouTube, Discord, ēnei rāua ko ngā tauira e whakamahia ana i ngā tikanga o te whakaatu me te whakawhitiwhiti i ngā whakaaro.
jobs.pastExperiencePlaceholder: Korero mai ki a maatau mo to BD, hononga, wheako hoko ranei e pa ana. Whakauruhia nga kamupene, nga umanga, me nga utu nui ki te tono...
jobs.whyHireYou: He aha te take i utua ai koe e matou?
jobs.whyHireYouPlaceholder: He aha e hanga koe te tangata tika mo tenei mahi? He aha te uara motuhake e kawea ana e koe ki DeHub?
jobs.nameEmailRequired: Ko te ingoa me te īmēra e hiahiatia ana
jobs.applicationSubmitted: He pai te tono i tukuna! Ka whakapā atu matou.
jobs.submitFailed: Kaore i taea te tuku. tēnā tamata ano.
jobs.ambassadorAbout: Hei karere tohu DeHub, ko koe te mata me te reo o te papa i roto i to hapori. Ko to mahi ko te horahanga i te kupu mo DeHub puta noa i nga hongere katoa e pa ana ki a koe — nga papaho pāpori, nga hui IRL, nga huihuinga petipeti, nga puni whare wananga, me tua atu. He mahi utu ia marama, ehara i te mahi a te komihana; ka whiwhi koe i te moni whiwhi ōrite i a koe e tipu ana i te taha o te papa.
jobs.ambResp1: Hangaia me te tohatoha i nga ihirangi pono mo DeHub puta noa i o hongere hapori whaiaro (X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, me etahi atu)
jobs.ambResp2: Whakauru kaha ki te hapori DeHub i runga i te taupānga — pou, kōrero, me te whakawhitiwhiti kōrero ki ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi
jobs.ambResp3: Haere, me te tohu DeHub i roto i ngā kaupapa tūturu, hui, me ngā hui i roto i to koutou rohe
jobs.ambResp4: I runga i nga kaiwhakamahi hou me nga kaihanga ki te papa ma to whatunga whaiaro
jobs.ambResp5: Whakaratohia nga urupare me nga whakaaro mai i te hapori hei awhina i te hanga i te mahere ara hua
jobs.ambWant1: Te aroaro o nga papaho pāpori mahi me te whakauru pono (te tatau whaiwhai he mea iti iho i te pono)
jobs.ambWant2: Te hiahia mo Web3, crypto, petipeti, ahurea kaihanga ranei
jobs.ambWant3: Ngā pūkenga whakawhitiwhiti kaha me te kaha ki te whakamārama i ngā ariā matatini noa iho
jobs.ambWant4: Ko te kaiarahi ake e taea ana te whakamahere me te whakahaere i nga kaupapa motuhake
jobs.ambWant5: Ko te karere o mua, te kaiwhakawhanake, te wheako whakahaere hapori ranei he bonus
jobs.ambassadorCompensation: Ka whiwhi nga Kaitohutohu Brand i te utu ka taea te whakawhitiwhitinga marama ka utua tonu. Ka taea te whakawhiwhia atu i nga bonus taapiri i runga i te mahi kaupapa, nga hainatanga kaiwhakamahi, me nga tohu tipu hapori. Ka whiwhi hoki koe i ngā hua DeHub motuhake, te uru wawe ki ngā āhuatanga, me ngā tohatoha tohu i te tipu o te taiao.
jobs.noRoleFits: Kaore koe e kite i tetahi mahi e tika ana? Haere mai ki a matou i runga i <mail>dev@dehub.io</mail> — kei te rapu tonu matou i nga tangata whai talenia.

depin.seoTitle: Te hanganga pāpāho e whakahaerehia ana e te hapori
depin.seoDescription: DeHub DePin ka taea e te iwi te tuku i te rokiroki, te bandwidth me te tātai ki te āwhina i te manaaki, te whakawhiti me te tuku pāpāho mā te whatunga pūmau.
depin.heroEyebrow: Te hanganga e whakahaerehia ana e te hapori
depin.heroTitle: To koutou taputapu. whatunga pāpāho DeHub.
depin.heroBlurb: Te tohatoha i te rokiroki rokiroki, te bandwidth me te tātai hei awhina i te manaaki, te whakawhiti me te tuku i nga ihirangi DeHub.
depin.heroImageAlt: He kōpae pātata e hono ana ki ngā whare me ngā whare hanga
depin.heroCaption: Kei te pupuri a DeHub i te kape taketake. Ka tāpiri ngā kōwae o te hapori i ngā tārua pūmau me te kaha tuku ā-rohe.
depin.earlyAccessBody: He kōpae ngawari, e hāngai ana ki te pūtirotiro e ora ana i raro nei. He aronga papamahi nui ake, i nga wa katoa i runga i te papamahi he aronga heke mai kua whakahuatia, kaore ano kia waatea. E kore e taea e te whai wāhi te whakarite i te utu.
depin.runFromTabTitle: Tikiake i te kōpaki i roto i tenei ripa.
depin.runFromTabBody: Kaore he whakauru, kaore he tango. Hokona i roto, tīpako i roto, a ka tīmata to koutou ripa pūtirotiro tuwhera ki te pupuri i te kape tuarua o etahi taonga pāpāho DeHub.
depin.statUnavailable: E wātea ana i teie nei.
depin.signInBlurb: Hokona ki te huri i tenei ripa pūtirotiro ki te node pūrua marama.
depin.optInBlurb: Tenei taumata rere katoa i roto i to koutou pūtirotiro mā te whakamahi i te rokiroki rohe (OPFS). Ka whai wāhi noa ia i te wā e tuwhera ana tēnei ripanga — ka mutu tō kōpae, ka whakatuwherahia anō, ka tīmata i tētahi hou. Kaore he whakauru, kaore he mea e rere ana i roto i te papamuri.
depin.unsupportedTitle: Kaore i tautokohia i roto i tenei kaitirotiro
depin.unsupportedBlurb: E hiahia ana ngā kōwae rokiroki pūtirotiro ki te tautoko Pūnaha Kōnae Tūmataiti, kāore tēnei pūtirotiro e tuku (he noa iho i runga i Safari). Whakamātauria he Chrome hou, Edge ranei Firefox i te wahi.
depin.rejectedTitle: E hiahia ana te hui ki te whakahou
depin.rejectedBlurb: I whakakahore te whatunga i te hui o tenei node, ko te tikanga ka mutu i te wa e tuwhera ana te whārangi. Hokona ano, me te whiriwhiri i roto i — kahore he mea i ngaro.
depin.connecting: Te hono atu ki a koe...
depin.dhbEarnedThisPeriod: Ngā tohu i whiwhi i tēnei wāhanga
depin.threeJobsTitle: Kotahi te mahi, e toru nga mahi whai hua.
depin.threeJobsBody: Ka whiriwhiri ngā kaiwhakahaere i ō rātou rohe rokiroki, bandwidth, me te tātai. DeHub whakarite anake te mahi e taea e to ratou mīhini te whakahaere haumaru.
depin.transcodeImageAlt: He mahi hanga whare e tuku ana i te kohinga GPU koreutu
depin.transcodeBody: Ka hurihia e nga miihini e tika ana te ataata ki nga putanga whakarereke. Ka tirohia nga putanga katoa i mua i te mahi.
depin.hostBody: Ka mau tonu nga waehere ki nga waahanga whakamunatanga, ki nga waahanga taapiri ihirangi ranei i roto i te cache rohe kua herea. Ko te rokiroki o DeHub te puna o te pono.
depin.deliverBody: Ka tohaina e nga hoa tata nga waahanga ataata i te wa e rite ana te huarahi tuku noa hei hinga aunoa.
depin.nodesLeaveTitle: He whatunga e tumanako ana kia haere nga nodes.
depin.nodesLeaveBody: Kaore he miihini hapori e pupuri i te kape anake. Ko nga tirotiro hauora, nga replicas me te putanga o te takenga mai me te pupuri i te playback e waatea ana.
depin.originBody: Tārua pūtake pūmau me te tuku hinga
depin.availableReplicasBody: Te mahi i nga waahanga kua oti te tirotiro e tata ana ki te tono
depin.offlineNodeBody: Haere atu i te ara tae noa ki te hono ano
depin.viewerBody: Whakamahia te hoa i te wa e wātea ana, te takenga mai i te wa e hiahiatia ana
depin.privacyTitle: Nga taonga hokohoko, kaore he urunga.
depin.privacyBody: Kei te noho tonu nga pāpāho tiaki ki te whakamunatanga i runga i nga taputapu hapori. Ka tukuna nga matua Playback motuhake ki nga kaitirotiro whai mana.
depin.protectedContentBody: Ka taea te rokiroki i ngā wāhanga ohaurunga, tūmataiti, me te utu-per-view hei ciphertext. Kaore nga kaiwhakahaere Node e whiwhi i nga matua tika na te mea e manaaki ana i nga raraunga.
depin.publicContentBody: Ka ārai te whakamunatanga i te tirotiro tūponotanga o ngā kōnae cached, engari kei te mātakitaki tonu ngā pāpāho tūmatanui mā te kaitākaro DeHub tūmatanui. E kore matou e tono atu i te tahi atu.
depin.operatorControlsBody: Ka whiriwhiri ngā kaiwhakahaere i ngā rohe kōpae, ngā rohe bandwidth, ngā haora mahi me ngā kāwai ihirangi tūmatanui e tika ana. Whakakorea nga panui e whakaoho ana i nga purges cache.
depin.verifiedWorkTitle: Ka tirohia te mahi whai hua. Ko nga utu e noho ana i te rereketanga.
depin.verifiedWorkBody: Ka whakatauria te takoha ma nga whiwhinga kua hainatia, nga tirotiro hauora me te whakamana whakaputa. Ko te rokiroki anake e kore e hanga i te utu.
depin.deliveryReceiptsBody: Kei te mahi nga poraka kua whakamanahia ki nga huihuinga takaro pono.
depin.availabilityBody: Ko nga tirotiro whakaora angitu me te ratonga pono i te wa e whakawhiwhia ana.
depin.validOutputBody: Me haere nga whakawhiti ki nga tirotiro kounga hangarau me te tauira.
depin.revenuePoolBody: Mena ka whakahohehia, ka whakatauhia he tahua utu mai i nga moni whiwhi papaaho i muri i te kati o te wa.
depin.noFixedRate: Kāore he reiti mōhio, he hua iti, he APY, he matapae anamata rānei. Ko ngā rekoata takoha he whakauru pūkete anake, ehara i te oati utu. Ko ngā whakataunga tohu a muri ake nei ka puta ki runga i te Base, ka noho tonu ki raro i te mana o te tika, ngā ture whatunga, me te ture e tika ana.
depin.runningCosts: Ko te whakahaere i te node e whakamahi ana i te hiko, te raraunga ipurangi me te ora taputapu. Kaore e taea e nga kaiwhakahaere te whiwhi i tetahi mea, a ka taea e o raatau utu te neke atu i tetahi utu.
depin.safestWorkloadTitle: I hangaia mai i te kawenga mahi haumaru rawa atu i waho.
depin.safestWorkloadBody: Ka tāpirihia e DePin te ara tuku o DeHub i mua. He nui ake te mahi e whai ake nei i muri i te whakamatau.
depin.deliveryBody: Peer-assisted ora me te tuku ataata ki te hinga aunoa.
depin.adaptiveVideoBody: He maha nga putanga mo te purei pono puta noa i nga tere hononga.
depin.desktopNodesBody: Te rokiroki kapi, te tirotiro bandwidth me te waatea kua whakamanahia.
depin.baseSettlementBody: Ko nga tono e utua ana e te moni ka utua anake i muri i te arotake whakahaere me te ture.
depin.faqOfflineQ: He aha te mea ka tupu i te wa e haere ana te node manaaki i runga i te ipurangi?
depin.faqOfflineA: Ka tangohia e te kaiwhakahaere i te ara mahi. Ko tetahi atu replica e mahi ana i te waahanga, ko te playback ranei ka hoki mai ki te rokiroki o DeHub i te wa e whakaritea ana nga kape whakakapi.
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeQ: Ka taea e te kaiwhakahaere node te kite i te ihirangi e manaaki ana ratou?
depin.faqCanOperatorSeeA: Kei te rokiroki ngā ihirangi tiaki hei wāhanga whakamunatanga, ā, kāore te kaihauturu e whiwhi i ngā kī tākaro. Kei te kitea tonu te ihirangi tūmatanui mā DeHub mā te hoahoa.
depin.faqHowMuchQ: E hia nga utu ka riro mai i te kaiwhakahaere node?
depin.faqHowMuchA: Kaore he utu tuuturu, he matapae ranei. Ka taea e te takoha kua whakamanahia te whiwhi i tetahi waahanga o te puna utu e utua ana i muri i te kati o te wa. Kaore e tiakina nga utu, a, ko te hiko, te bandwidth me nga utu taputapu ka nui ake i nga utu katoa.
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableQ: Kei te wātea te pūmanawa node inaianei?
depin.faqSoftwareAvailableA: He tiera ngawari, e hāngai ana i runga i te pūtirotiro e wātea ana i tenei ra: haina i roto, me te whiriwhiri i runga i tenei whārangi, a ka riro to koutou ripa tuwhera he node i te wa e tuwhera ana. He aronga papamahi nui ake, i nga wa katoa i runga i te papamahi he aronga heke mai kua whakahuatia — kaore ano kia noho.
depin.faqInstallNeededQ: E hiahia ana ahau ki te tāuta i tetahi mea mo te pūtirotiro node?
depin.faqInstallNeededA: Kaore. Ka rere katoa i roto i te ripa ma te whakamahi i te rokiroki rohe o to kaitirotiro. Ko te kati i te ripa ka mutu to node; kaore he ratonga papamuri me te whakauru.
depin.ctaTitle: Ka tīmata anake i te wa e haumaru ana te hapa.
depin.ctaBody: Ko te putanga o te takenga mai, ko nga pāpāho tiaki kua whakamunatia me te mahi kua whakamanahia ka tae mai i mua i nga utu a te iwi.
depin.footerNote: Ko te whakauru DePin he ratonga takoha, ehara i te hua haumi. Ka taea te huri i te waatea, te tika me nga utu.

migrate.costsIntro: He iti ake te utu o ia video i te mea i mua — ka heke te reiti i te whakatupuranga o te batch, no reira ko te utu i raro nei he utu katoa mo taua maha o nga video.

svgPath.data: SVG markup tēnei, me ngā kōrero kīanga (d)
svgPath.hint: Paste ara d raraunga ranei tohu SVG taketake ki ara, rectangles, porowhita, ellipses, raina me polygons. Ka tautokohia nga whakahau neke, raina, cubic, quadratic, maeneene me te arc. Ko te matrix SVG, ko te whakamaori, ko te rahinga, ko te hurihanga hurihuri me te hurihuri e pupuri ana i to raatau ahupūngao. Ka whakamahia e te Geometry to tae whiriwhiri; kaore i te kawemai nga peita taketake, nga peita me nga tohu tirohanga. Ka riro ngā kōpae i ngā tohu whakairoiro tauira. Tikiake i te ara ki Z ki te whakakii i te reira. Ka taea te whakakii i nga waahanga SVG kua kati. He maha nga waahanga ka whakakotahihia nga papa e taea te whakatika; kaore i te tautokohia nga poka whakaranu.

glossary.fractionsDesc: Ko te pou ka whakaputaina ki DeHub ka huri hei NFT kua wehea ki ngā wāhanga 1,000, ā, ka tīmata te kaihanga me ngā wāhanga 1,000 katoa — 100% te mana whai i te ihirangi. Kāore he here kia whakaputaina, ā, ka taea i te wā e tuku ana koe, ā muri ake rānei.
glossary.ownershipBarDesc: He pae kauneke i te whārangi Mōhiohio Pou e whakaatu ana e hia o ngā wāhanga 1,000 kei te kaihanga tonu, e hia kua tohaina, kua hokona rānei.
glossary.tokenIdDesc: He tautuhi ahurei i runga i te mekameka ka riro i tētahi pou ina whakaputaina hei NFT ki te poraka mekameka. Kāore he here kia whakaputaina, nō reira kāore anō he Token ID o te pou kāore anō kia whakaputaina.
glossary.tokenIdInfoDesc: Te tautuhi ahurei i runga i te mekameka ka riro i tētahi pou ina whakaputaina hei NFT. Ka whakaaturia ki runga rawa o te whārangi Mōhiohio Pou mō ngā pou kua whakaputaina.
glossary.tipDesc: Tukua ngā tohu DeHub tika ki tētahi kaihanga ihirangi hei utu mō tō rātou ihirangi. Ka tuhia ngā tohutohu ki runga i te mekameka.
glossary.ppvDesc: Ngā ihirangi moni e hiahiatia ana he utu i roto i ngā tohu DeHub kia wātea ai. Ka whakatauhia te utu e ngā kaihanga, ā, ka whiwhi hua rātou i ia tirohanga.
glossary.totalTipsDesc: E whakaatu ana i te tapeke o ngā tohutohu kua whiwhi te pou mai i ngā kaimātakitaki, e whakaatuhia ana i te whārangi Mōhiohio Pou.
glossary.listFractionsDesc: Mēnā kei a koe ngā wāhanga o tētahi pou, ka taea e koe te whakarārangi hei hoko i te utu e whakatauhia ana e koe (i ngā tohu ia wāhanga). Ka taea e ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi te hoko i ō wāhanga kua whakarārangitia.
glossary.dhbTokenDesc: Ko te tohu whaihua taketake o DeHub. Ko te DHB te tohu tohu mō ngā tohu DeHub. Ka whakamahia mō te tohutohu, te utu-ia-tirohanga ihirangi, te pōti whakahaere, me te whakapūātanga.
glossary.walletDesc: Tō putea i runga i te mekameka e pupuri ana i ō tohu DeHub me ētahi atu rawa crypto. Ka honoa mā te Web3Auth mō te ngāwari o te uru.
glossary.stakingDesc: Raka ō tohu DeHub kia whiwhi ai koe i ngā utu i te wā. Ka nui ake hoki te mana pōti o ngā tohu kua whakapūātia i roto i te whakahaere.
glossary.governanceDesc: Tukua, pōtitia ngā tono e hanga ana i te papa. Ka whakataungia tō mana pōti e ō pupuri tohu DeHub.
glossary.stakingBadgeDesc: Ngā tohu e whakaatuhia ana i te taha o tō ingoa kaiwhakamahi i runga i te tapeke o ō pupuri tohu DeHub (pūtea + whakapūātia). E 13 ngā taumata — te nui ake o ngā tohu e pupuri ana koe, te teitei ake o tō taumata tohu. Ka nui ake te mana pōti whakahaere me te iti ake o ngā utu papa nā ngā taumata teitei ake. Ka utua ngā taumata i roto i ngā tāra, nā reira ka heke te maha o ngā tohu e hiahiatia ana e ia i te pikinga o te utu o te tohu — ā, ka wātea ana tētahi taumata māu, ka mau tonu ki a koe mō te roa o tō pupuri i te utu mō taua mea, ahakoa te aha te utu i muri mai.
glossary.badgeRequires: E hiahiatia ana {{amount}} tohu · {{fee}}% utu papa
glossary.leaderboardRankingDesc: Ka whakarōrangitia ngā kaiwhakamahi e te tapeke o te toenga tohu DeHub (pūtea + whakapūātia puta noa i ngā mekameka katoa). Ka whakahoutia ngā whakarōrangitanga i ngā wā, ā, ka whai i ngā huringa 1-ra me te 1-wiki. Ka taea hoki e koe te tātari mā te tohutohu i tukua, tohutohu i riro mai, ngā kaiwhai, ngā pai, me ngā kaiohauru.
glossary.thumbsUpDesc: Whakaatu e hiahia ana koe ranei whakaae ki te pou. Whakanuia te tohu whakauru o te pou me te awhina i te taumata teitei ake i roto i te kai.
glossary.thumbsDownDesc: E whakaatu ana koe e kore koe e pai, e kore ranei e whakaae ki te pou. Ka āwhina tēnei urupare ki te whakapai ake i ngā taunakitanga ihirangi.
glossary.commentDesc: Whakatuwherahia te waahanga korero ka taea ai e koe te whakautu ki tetahi pou, uru atu ki nga korerorero, me te whakawhitiwhiti korero ki etahi atu kaiwhakamahi.
glossary.shareDesc: Hokona he pou i waho ma te hono, ka kape ranei i te URL pou ki to papapātuhi hei tuku atu ki etahi atu.
glossary.bookmarkDesc: Tiakina he pou ki o tohu pukapuka mo muri ake nei. Whakauru i nga pou katoa kua tiakina mai i te whaarangi Bookmarks i te taha taha.
glossary.reportDesc: Flag ihirangi kore e tika, kino ranei mō te arotake. Ka āwhina ngā pūrongo ki te pupuri i te hapori haumaru.
glossary.moreOptionsDesc: Whakatuwherahia etahi atu mahi penei i te whakatika, te whakakore, te ripoata ranei i tetahi pou.
glossary.translateButtonDesc: Whakamaori i te kuputuhi pou, bios, me ngā kōrero i roto i to koutou reo tino. Ko te taupānga auto-detects koutou reo pūtirotiro ranei ka taea e koe te whakaturia tetahi ringa i roto i Tautuhinga.
glossary.showOriginalDesc: Whai muri i te whakamāoritanga, patohia tēnei kia hoki anō ki te reo taketake o te ihirangi.
glossary.imagePostDesc: He poutāpeta kei roto kotahi, neke atu rānei ngā atahanga. Ka tiakina ngā atahanga ki runga i te mekameka hei NFT me tētahi ID Tohu ahurei.
glossary.videoPostDesc: He poutāpeta kei roto he ataata. Ka taea te tautuhi i ngā ataata kia tūmatanui, kia tūmataiti, kia utua rānei mō te mātakitaki (PPV).
glossary.liveStreamDesc: He pāhotanga tūturu. Ka taea e ngā mātakitaki te mātakitaki, te kōrero, me te tuku koha ki te kaipāho. Ka whakamahia e ngā pāhotanga te hangarau HLS heke-iti.
glossary.storyDesc: He ihirangi ataata poto ka pau i muri i te 24 hāora. Patohia te porowhita avatar o tētahi kaiwhakamahi i te whāngai kāinga kia mātakitaki i tā rātou kōrero.
glossary.audioDesc: He poutāpeta ororongo me te kaitākaro ngaru ataata. Ka taea e ngā kaihanga te tukuake i te puoro, i ngā pōkākā, i ngā rekoata reo rānei.
glossary.audioSpaceDesc: He rūma ororongo ora ka taea e ngā kaiwhakamahi te kōrero, te whakarongo, me te hiki i tō rātou ringa kia uru atu ki te kōrerorero.
glossary.publicDesc: He ihirangi e kitea ana e te katoa. Ka taea e te tangata te mātakitaki, te pai, me te kōrero ki ngā poutāpeta tūmatanui.
glossary.privateDesc: He ihirangi e kitea ana e koe anake. Ka huna ngā poutāpeta tūmataiti i ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi me te whāngai tūmatanui.
glossary.subscriberOnlyDesc: He ihirangi e herea ana ki ngā kaiwhakamahi kua ohauru ki te hongere a te kaihanga.
glossary.postInfoPageDesc: He tirohanga taipitopito o tētahi poutāpeta e whakaatu ana i ōna raraunga i runga i te mekameka, ngā tatauranga whai wāhi, ngā wāhanga nōhanga, me ngā mōhiohio kaihanga. Uru atu mā te pato i te ata "ⓘ" i runga i tētahi poutāpeta.
glossary.txHashInfoDesc: Te hash tauwhitinga poraka mai i te wā i hangaia ai te poutāpeta. Pāwhiritia kia whakatuwhera i te kaitirotiro poraka (BaseScan, BscScan rānei) me te manatoko i te rekoata i runga i te mekameka.
glossary.engagementStatsDesc: E whakaatu ana te whārangi Mōhiohio Poutāpeta i te tapeke o ngā pai, ngā kāore i te pai, ngā mātakitaki, ngā kōrero, me ngā koha i riro mai — e homai ana i tētahi whakaahua oti o te mahi a te poutāpeta.
glossary.visibilityControlDesc: Ka taea e ngā kaipupuri poutāpeta te huri i te whakaaturanga o tā rātou poutāpeta i waenga i te Tūmatanui (ka kitea e te katoa), te Kāore i Rārangitia (mā te hono hāngai anake), me te Tūmataiti (ko koe anake). Ka taea te uru atu i te whārangi Mōhiohio Poutāpeta.
glossary.unlistedDesc: He tautuhinga kitea e kore ai te pouaka kōrero e puta ki ngā hāngai, ki te rapu rānei, engari ka taea tonu e te tangata whai hononga tika te tiro.
glossary.editFromInfo: Whakatika Pouaka Kōrero (mai i te Mōhiohio)
glossary.editFromInfoDesc: Ka taea e ngā kaipupuri pouaka kōrero te whakatika i te taitara me te whakaahuatanga o tā rātou pouaka kōrero mai i te whārangi Mōhiohio Pouaka Kōrero mā te pato i te pātene whakatika.
glossary.totalTips: Tapeke o ngā Tohu i Whiwhia
glossary.ppvPurchasesDesc: Mō ngā pouaka kōrero utu-mā-te-tiro, e whakaatu ana i te maha o ngā kaiwhakamahi kua hoko i te urunga me te tapeke o te moni i whiwhia e te kaihanga.
glossary.holdersDesc: Te rārangi o ngā wāhitau pēke e pupuri ana i ngā wāhanga o tētahi pouaka kōrero. Ka whakaatuhia ki te whārangi Mōhiohio Pouaka Kōrero me te toenga me te ōrau pupuri o ia kaipupuri.
glossary.fractionMarketplaceDesc: Te ripa mākete i te whārangi Mōhiohio Pouaka Kōrero e taea ai e ngā kaipupuri wāhanga te rārangi i ā rātou wāhanga mō te hoko, ā, ka taea e ngā kaihoko te tuku tono. Ka taea ai te hokohoko i te pupuri ihirangi.
glossary.makeOfferDesc: Tukuna he tono hoko mō ngā wāhanga o tētahi pouaka kōrero i te utu e whiriwhiria ana e koe. Ka taea e te kaipupuri wāhanga te whakaae, te whakakore rānei i tō tono.
glossary.swapDesc: Whakawhitia tētahi tohu mō tētahi atu i roto tonu i te taupānga. Ka puta ngā whakawhitinga i runga i te mekameka mā te whakamahi i ngā whakawhitinga whakaheke pokapū.
glossary.txHashDesc: He tohu tautuhi ahurei mō ngā whakawhitinga i runga i te mekameka. Pāwhiria kia tirohia ngā taipitopito whakawhitinga katoa i runga i te pūtirotiro poraka.
glossary.followersDesc: Whāia ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi kia kite i ā rātou pouaka kōrero i tō hāngai. Ka whakaatuhia tō tatau kaiwhai i tō kōtaha.
glossary.notificationsDesc: Ngā matohi mō ngā pai, ngā kōrero, ngā tohu, ngā whai, me ētahi atu mahi e pā ana ki tō pūkete.
glossary.dmDesc: Ngā karere tūmataiti i waenga i ngā kaiwhakamahi. Kei te wātea i tēnei wā i runga i te taupānga pūkoro, ā, ka tae mai te tautoko tukutuku ākuanei.
glossary.mentionDesc: Tohua tētahi atu kaiwhakamahi i tētahi pouaka kōrero, kōrero rānei mā te pato i te @ me tōna ingoa kaiwhakamahi. Ka whiwhi rātou i tētahi pānui.
glossary.homeFeedDesc: Ko tō kai matua e whakaatu ana i ngā pou mai i ngā tāngata e whai ana koe, e whai ana hoki i ngā ihirangi e whai ana koe.
glossary.exploreDesc: Kimihia ngā ihirangi hou me ngā kaiwhakamahi. Whakanohoia e te kāwai: ataata, whakaahua, rere ora, me te ake.
glossary.leaderboardDesc: Rankings o runga kaiwhakamahi i te toenga, tohutohu tonoa, tohutohu riro, kaiwhaiwhai, me te ake. whakahoutia auau.
glossary.assistantDesc: He kaiawhina kōrerorero AI e taea te whakautu i ngā pātai, te whakaputa whakaahua, te hanga ataata, me te āwhina ki ngā āhuatanga papaaho.
glossary.settingsDesc: Whakahaerehia o hiahia kaute, reo, tautuhinga tūmataiti, me te ahua.
glossary.featureRequestsDesc: Tūhono mai ki ngā huarahi hou, whakapā mai ki ngā pūrongo o te hapori. E whakaputa ana ngā pūrongo hou, whakapā mai ki ngā pūrongo o te hapori.
glossary.upvoteDesc: Te pōti i runga i te kaupapa whakahaere, i te tono āhuatanga rānei. Āwhina i te tautoko hapori tohu.
glossary.downvoteDesc: Te pōti ki tētahi kaupapa whakahaere, ki tētahi tono āhuatanga rānei. Ka awhina i te hunga e whakahe ana i te hapori.
glossary.deltaDesc: Ko te pere matomato, whero ranei i te taha o te tomokanga kaiarahi e whakaatu ana i te nui o te toenga o te kaiwhakamahi i te wa i tohua (1 ra, 1 wiki, me etahi atu).
glossary.editDesc: Hurihia te taitara, te whakaahua ranei o te pou i hangaia e koe. Ko te kaihanga taketake anake e taea te whakatika i to ratou pou.
glossary.deleteDesc: Tangohia tonu he pou i roto i te kai. Kei te noho tonu te rekoata ipurangi engari kaore ano kia whakaatuhia te ihirangi.
glossary.pinDesc: Tūhia te pātaka ki runga o tōu pūrongo, kia kitea ai e ngā manuhiri i te tuatahi.
glossary.viewOnExplorerDesc: Whakatuwherahia te kaitirotiro blockchain (BaseScan) ki te tiro i nga taipitopito whakawhitiwhitinga i runga i te raka mo te pou, whakawhiti ranei.
glossary.title: Kupu Whakaahua
glossary.subtitle: Akohia he aha te tikanga o ia tohu me nga ahuatanga

tipFunding.noRoute: Kaore he huarahi Uniswap ki nga tohu DeHub mo tenei tohu i tenei wa
tipFunding.lowLiquidity: Kāore i te nui te moniwai i Uniswap mō tētahi utu pēnei te rahi i tēnei wā
tipFunding.dpayNoAmount: Kāore a DeHub Pay i whakahoki mai i te rahi o te utu
tipFunding.dpayDelayed: Kei a DeHub Pay to utu me te tuku i nga tohu. Ka tae mai ratou i roto i to koutou putea i roto i te wa tata; tukua ano i te wa e mahi ratou.
tipFunding.noBridgeRoute: Kāore he ara whakawhiti-mekameka e wātea ana i tēnei wā
tipFunding.bridgeCancelled: I whakakorea te tono whakawhiti-mekameka, ā, kua whakahokia ki tō pūkoro
tipFunding.bridgeSlow: He roa ake te whakawhitinga whakawhiti-mekameka i te tikanga. Ka tae ki tō pūkoro i Base; tukuna anō ina tae mai.
tipFunding.txFailed: Kāore i whakaūngia te tauwhitinga. Kāore he mea i whakapaua.
tipFunding.notEnoughOnBase: Kāore i te nui ngā {{symbol}} i Base mō tēnei utu
tipFunding.notEnoughWithFees: Kāore i te nui ngā {{symbol}} mō tēnei utu, tae atu ki ngā utu whatunga

raffle.ticketBody: Ko ētahi o ngā whakawhiwhinga ka hokona hoki he tiikiti i utua ki ngā tohu DeHub. Ki te pērā, ka whakaputaina te utu me te rohe mō ia pūkete i mua.
raffle.faqPurchaseAnswer: Kāore. Kei ia whakawhiwhinga te iti rawa o tētahi ara whakauru kore utu, ka whiwhi mā te whai wāhi ki DeHub. Ko ētahi atu whakawhiwhinga ka hokona he tiikiti i utua ki ngā tohu DeHub, engari kāore he tiikiti te ara anake hei whakauru.
raffle.heroBody: Ko ngā whakawhiwhinga tohu DeHub ka tohatoha i ngā tohu DeHub, taputapu me ngā taonga kohikohi ki ngā tāngata kua whakamahi kē i te papaa. Ka whiwhi ngā whakauru mā te whai wāhi, ka whakaputaina te rārangi whakauru i mua i te whakahaere o te whakawhiwhinga, ka tohua te toa mā te whakawhitiwhiti ka taea e te katoa te pānui.
raffle.noPurchase: Kāore he hoko e hiahiatia ana. Kei ia whakawhiwhinga te ara whakauru kore utu, ā, ki te tukua he tiikiti, kāore ia e te ara anake hei whakauru.

badgeLadder.intro: Ka utu te taumata katoa i tētahi moni kua whakaritea i roto i ngā tāra. Ko te tau tohu kei te taha o taua ko te utu o taua i te 0.001 $ te utu tohutoro — ka tono te taupānga mō taua tau kua whakaritea ki te utu ora, ā, kāore rawa he nui ake i tērā, nō reira kāore e taea e te heke o te utu te whakanui ake i te pae, te tango rānei i tētahi taumata kua oti kē i a koe.

postingAllowance.footnote: Ko te taumata tohu ko ō tohu DeHub kua pupurihia me te tāwhiri i runga i te BNB Chain me te Base — te pauna rite tonu e tangohia ai tō tohu. Ka utua te arawhiti ki ngā tāra, nō reira ko ngā tau tohu i runga ake nei ko te utu o ia taumata i te 0.001 $ te utu hoko, ā, ka heke te whakaritenga i te pikinga o te utu o te tohu; kāore he taumata kua oti kē i a koe e tangohia ana e te utu. Ko te tohu i hoatu ki a koe e te kaitautoko ka puta ki tō kōtuku engari kāore e whakanui ake tō whakaaetanga whakaputa — ka puta mai tērā i tō pupuri ake. Ka tautuhi anō ngā whakaaetanga i te 00:00 UTC, ā, ko te gigabyte i konei ko te 1,024 MB.

getting-started.title: Te Timata
getting-started.intro: E rima ngā ara ki DeHub, ā, kāore he mea e hiahiatia ana kia whai putea koe: Google, Apple, he waehere i tukuna ki to imeera, he waehere i tukuna mā te SMS, he putea rānei kei a koe ka honoa e koe. Ko ngā mea katoa engari ko te ara putea ka hanga he putea kore-tiaki māu i muri — kei a koe ngā kī, ā, ka tautoko a DeHub i te hau kia taea ai e koe te tuku panui, te tohutohu, me te kohikohi me te kore e hoko tohu taketake.

steps.1: Tirohia te dehub.io — ko te whāngai kāinga te whārangi mua, kia taea ai e koe te titiro huri i mua i te hainatanga.
steps.2: Pāwhiritia te 'Haina'. Ka kite koe i a Google me Apple, ngā wāhi mō tētahi wahitau imeera, tau waea rānei, me te 'Hono Putea' mō tētahi kei a koe.
steps.3: Ki a Google, Apple rānei, whakaoti te rere o te kaiwhakarato. Ki te imeera, SMS rānei, tomo te waehere ka tae mai.
steps.4: Ka hangaia he putea, ka tiakina māu i te hainatanga tuatahi. Ko te hono i to ake putea ka hiahia kia kotahi te hainatanga hei whakaatu i te wāhitau.
steps.5: Kōwhiria he ingoa kaiwhakamahi. Ko te mea ka kitea e ngā tangata, ā, ka rua hei hononga ki to kōtaha dehub.io/<username>.
steps.6: Kua uru koe. Tirohia te whāngai, whakaritea to kōtaha, ka timata te tuku panui.

tips.1: Ko ngā hainatanga pāpori, imeera, SMS rānei kāore e utu hau — ka tautoko a DeHub. Ko ngā putea honoa ka utu i ta rātou ake ETH, BNB rānei.
tips.2: Kei te hoki mai ki tētahi kaute DeHub tawhito? Haina mā te imeera, tau waea rānei i whakamahia e ia, ā, ka kitea e te hekenga.
tips.3: Ka taea e koe te pupuri i ngā kaute maha i runga i tētahi pūrere, ka huri i waenganui i a rātou i roto i ngā Tautuhinga → Kōtaha.

home-feed.title: Whāngai Kāinga
home-feed.intro: Ko te whāngai kāinga te wāhi ka kite koe i ngā panui mai i ngā tangata e whai ana koe me ngā ihirangi rongonui. Ka tautoko i ngā ripa momo ihirangi maha me ngā kōwhiringa tātari.

steps.1: Neke ki te /app — koinei to whāngai kāinga.
steps.2: Whakamahia ngā ripa o runga hei tātari mā te momo ihirangi: Kāinga (katoa), Ataata, Ngā Whakaahua, Ngā Pāpāho Poto, Waiata, me ngā Rere Ora.
steps.3: Panuku mauī/matau ki ngā ripa kia kitea ai ētahi atu kōwhiringa ki te pūkoro.
steps.4: Whakamahia te pātene tātari/taurangi (tōpito-matau o te pātaka) hei whakarerekē i te tūnga: Wera, Hou, me te Tōpito.
steps.5: Tōia kia whakahōhouhia te pātaka ki te pūkoro.
steps.6: Panuku ki raro kia utaina atu ai ngā whakairinga mā te aunoa (panuku mutunga kore).
steps.7: Hurihia i waenga i te Tirohanga Matiti me te Tirohanga Pātaka mā te whakamahi i te whakawhiti āhuahanga.

tips.1: He pai te Tirohanga Matiti mō te tirotiro tere i ngā whakaahua.
tips.2: Ko te ripa 'Kāinga' e whakaatu ana i ngā momo ihirangi katoa kua whakaranua.
tips.3: Ko te ripa Ora e whakaatu ana i ngā rerenga ora e kaha ana i tēnei wā.

creating-posts.title: Te Waihanga Whakairinga
creating-posts.intro: Waihangahia ngā whakairinga kuputuhi, tohaina ngā whakaahua, ataata, reo-rongo, GIF, me ētahi atu. Whakamahia ngā hashtags, cashtags, me ngā whakahuatanga hei whakanui i te toronga.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te pātene 'Whakairinga' i te taha taha (desktop) me te pātene + (pūkoro).
steps.2: Pāhia tō kuputuhi ki te wāhi tuhituhi.
steps.3: Hei tāpiri i tētahi whakaahua, ataata rānei, pāwhiritia te ata pāpāho ka kōwhiri i tētahi konae.
steps.4: Hei tuhi i tētahi reo-rongo, pāwhiritia te ata hopuoro.
steps.5: Hei tāpiri i tētahi GIF, pāwhiritia te ata GIF ka rapu i tētahi.
steps.6: Whakamahia ngā #hashtags hei whakarōpū i tō whakairinga (hei tauira, #crypto, #defi).
steps.7: Whakamahia ngā $cashtags hei tohutoro i ngā tohu (hei tauira, $DHB, $ETH).
steps.8: Whakamahia ngā @mentions hei tohu i ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi (hei tauira, @username).
steps.9: Pāwhiritia te 'Whakairinga' hei whakaputa. Ka puta tō whakairinga ki te pātaka tonu.

tips.1: Ka tautoko ngā whakairinga i te whakatakanga momo markdown.
tips.2: Ka taea e koe te whakairinga-kōrero mā te pāwhiri i te ata repost i runga i tētahi whakairinga ka kōwhiri i te 'Kōrero'.
tips.3: Ka puta ngā kāwai (hashtags) ki te papa whakataetae 'Kōrero o te Taone'.

interacting-with-posts.title: Te Whakawhitiwhiti ki ngā Whakairinga
interacting-with-posts.intro: Whakawhitiwhiti ki te ihirangi mā te pōti, te kōrero, te tohutohu, te tiaki pukapuka, te tohutohu, me te whakamaori.

steps.1: Pōtitia whakarunga, whakararo rānei tētahi whakairinga mā te whakamahi i ngā ata pere kei te taha mauī o tētahi whakairinga.
steps.2: Pāwhiritia te ata kōrero hei whakatuwhera i te wāhanga kōrero ka waiho he whakautu.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia te ata kohatu/tohunga hei tuku i tētahi tohunga ki ngā tohu DeHub ki te kaihanga whakairinga.
steps.4: Pāwhiritia te ata tiaki pukapuka hei whakaora i tētahi whakairinga mō muri mai.
steps.5: Pāwhiritia te ata tohutohu hei kōkopi i te hono whakairinga me te tohutohu ki waho.
steps.6: Pāwhiritia te paatene whakamaori (tohu ao) i runga i tetahi pou hei whakamaori i te tuhingi ki to reo.
steps.7: Mo nga pou whakaahua, whakamahia te paatene 'Whakamaori Whakaahua' kia whiwhi ai koe i te putanga kua whakamaoritia e te AI o te tuhingi kei roto i te ahua.
steps.8: Pāwhiritia tetahi pou hei whakatuwhera i roto i te tirohanga pou kotahi mata-katoa.

tips.1: Ko nga tohutohu ka haere tika ki te putea a te kaihanga i roto i nga tohu DeHub.
tips.2: Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i te nui o te tohutohu ma te paatene tere-kōwhiri, ka uru ranei ki tetahi nui ritenga.
tips.3: Ko nga pou kua tohua ka uru atu mai i te wharangi Tohu i te taha taha.

explore-search.title: Tirotiro me te Rapu
explore-search.intro: Tirohia nga ihirangi me nga kaiwhakamahi hou na roto i te wharangi tirotiro me te kaha rapu.

steps.1: Haere ki te /app/explore mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Whakamahia te pae rapu kei runga hei rapu kaiwhakamahi, pou, me nga ihirangi.
steps.3: Tātarihia nga hua ma te ripa: Katoa, Tangata, Pou, Whakaahua, Ataata, Waiata, Ora.
steps.4: Tirotiro nga kaupapa rongonui me nga waahanga kei te wharangi tirotiro.
steps.5: Pāwhiritia tetahi kaupapa rongonui kia kite i nga pou katoa e pa ana.
steps.6: Pāwhiritia tetahi kaiwhakamahi i roto i nga hua rapu kia toro atu ki ta raatau korero.

tips.1: Ko te rapu e tautoko ana i nga ingoa kaiwhakamahi, nga wahitau putea, me nga kupu matua ihirangi.
tips.2: Ka whakahouhia nga kaupapa rongonui i runga i nga mahi whakaputa tata nei.

profile.title: Kōtaha
profile.intro: Ko to korero e whakaatu ana i o pou, kaiwhai, whai, me nga korero putea.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia to avatar, 'Kōtaha' ranei i te taha taha kia kite i to korero.
steps.2: Pāwhiritia 'Whakatika Kōtaha' hei whakahou i to ingoa whakaatu, bio, me to avatar.
steps.3: Tukuna he pikitia korero ma te paatene i to avatar i te aratau whakatika.
steps.4: Tirohia o tatauranga kaiwhai me te whai i runga i to wharangi korero.
steps.5: Tirotiro i o ake pou, pāpāho, me nga ihirangi i pai ki a koe na roto i nga ripa korero.
steps.6: Kopirihia to wahitau putea ma te paatene i te tohu kape i muri i a ia.
steps.7: Toro atu ki nga korero a etahi atu kaiwhakamahi ma te paatene i o raatau ingoa kaiwhakamahi, avatar ranei i nga waahi katoa o te papaa.

tips.1: He ahurei to ingoa kaiwhakamahi, ka puta ki to URL korero (dehub.io/@username).
tips.2: Ma nga tautuhinga tūmataiti ka taea e koe te whakahaere ko wai ka kite i o tatauranga kaiwhai.

messages.title: Karere
messages.intro: Tukuna nga karere tika ki etahi atu kaiwhakamahi i runga i te papaa.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia 'Karere' i te taha taha hei whakatuwhera i te wharangi karere.
steps.2: Pāwhiritia te paatene tuhituhi kia tīmata ai he kōrero hou.
steps.3: Rapua he kaiwhakamahi mā te ingoa kaiwhakamahi kia īmēra atu ki a ia.
steps.4: Tuhia tō karere, ka pēhi i te tuku.
steps.5: Tirohia tō hītori kōrero i roto i te rārangi karere.
steps.6: Pāwhiritia tētahi kōrero kia haere tonu te korerorero.

tips.1: Ka whiwhi koe i tētahi whakamōhiotanga ka īmēra mai tētahi ki a koe.
tips.2: Ka taea e ngā kaihanga te raka ngā karere ki muri i te whakaritenga tohutohu.

ai-assistant.title: Kaiawhina AI
ai-assistant.intro: Kōrero ki te kaiawhina AI kua oti te hanga o DeHub mō te āwhina, mō ngā mōhiohio, me ngā mahi auaha.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te 'Kaiawhina' i te taha taha kia whakatuwheratia te kōrero AI.
steps.2: Tuhia tō pātai, tō tono rānei i te whakaurunga kōrero.
steps.3: Ka taea e te AI te āwhina ki ngā mōhiohio crypto, ki ngā pātai papaa, me ngā mōhiohio whānui.
steps.4: Tīmata tētahi kōrero hou mā te pāwhiri i te paatene kōrero hou.
steps.5: Tirohia tō hītori kōrero i te taha taha o te whārangi kaiawhina.
steps.6: Ka taea e koe te whakapiri pikitia kia tātarihia e te AI.

tips.1: Ka mahara te AI ki te horopaki i roto i tētahi kōrero.
tips.2: Ka taea e koe te pātai ki te AI mō ngā āhuatanga o DeHub, ngā kupu crypto, me ngā pātai whānui.
tips.3: Ka tiakina ngā kōrero o mua, ka taea te uru atu i ngā wā katoa.

notifications.title: Ngā whakamōhiotanga
notifications.intro: Kia whakahoutia ki ngā pai, ngā kōrero, ngā tohutohu, ngā whai, me ngā atu mahi i runga i tō ihirangi.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te ata pere, te 'Ngā whakamōhiotanga' rānei i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tirohia ngā whakamōhiotanga katoa i roto i tētahi rārangi wā.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia tētahi whakamōhiotanga kia neke ki te ihirangi e pā ana.
steps.4: Kei roto i ngā whakamōhiotanga: ngā kaiwhai hou, ngā pōti pou, ngā kōrero, ngā tohutohu, me ngā whakahuatanga.
steps.5: Ka tohua ngā whakamōhiotanga kāore anō kia pānuihia — ka tohua hei pānui ka tirohia.

tips.1: Ko te tohu whakamōhiotanga e whakaatu ana i te maha o ngā whakamōhiotanga kāore anō kia pānuihia.
tips.2: Ko ngā whakamōhiotanga tohutohu e whakaatu ana i te maha o ngā tohu i whiwhi koe.

wallet.title: Pukoro
wallet.intro: Tirohia ngā toenga tohu DeHub i runga i ngā mekameka maha, tirohia ngā tāpui whakauru, ka whakahaere i ō rawa.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te 'Pukoro' i te taha taha kia whakatuwheratia te whārangi pukoro.
steps.2: Tirohia tō katoa o ngā tohu toenga i whakahiato ki ngā mekameka tautokona katoa.
steps.3: Tirohia ngā whakahaere mō ia mekameka: Ethereum, Base, BNB Chain, me ētahi atu.
steps.4: Tirohia āu putunga rahui me ngā utu.
steps.5: Pāwhiritia te 'Refresh Scan' hei whakahou i āu toenga mai i ngā raraunga mekameka.
steps.6: Kōpi tō wāhitau putea ki te whiwhi tohu mai i ētahi atu.

tips.1: Ka whakahou aunoa ngā toenga engari ka taea e koe te kaha ki te whakahou i ngā wā katoa.
tips.2: E whakaatu ana te putea i ngā toenga wai (e wātea ana) me ngā toenga rahui.

staking.title: Rahui
staking.intro: Rahuia āu tohu DeHub kia whiwhi ai koe i ngā utu, kia piki ai tō mana pooti whakahaere.

steps.1: Haere ki te whārangi 'Staking' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Whakauruhia te maha o ngā tohu e hiahia ana koe ki te rahui.
steps.3: Tīpakohia te mekameka e hiahia ana koe ki te rahui.
steps.4: Whakaūngia te tauwhitinga i roto i tō putea (ngā putea o waho) ka whakahaerehia aunoatia (social login).
steps.5: Tirohia āu moni rahui me ngā utu tatari.
steps.6: Hei un-stake, whakauruhia te moni ka whakaūngia te tauwhitinga un-stake.

tips.1: Ka piki te rahui i tō taumaha pooti i roto i ngā tono whakahaere.
tips.2: Kāore ngā kaiwhakamahi Social-login e hiahia ana ki te hau kia rahui — he kore hau.
tips.3: Ka taea e koe te rahui ki ngā mekameka maha i te wā kotahi.

leaderboard.title: Papatohu
leaderboard.intro: Tirohia ko wai kei runga! Ka whakarōrangitia e te papatohu ngā kaiwhakamahi mā te toenga, te whakapau o ia rā, me ngā kaupapa rongonui.

steps.1: Haere ki te whārangi 'Leaderboard' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tohua i waenga i ngā ripa: Balance, Daily Spent, me Talk of the Town.
steps.3: Ko te ripa Balance ka whakarōrangitia ngā kaiwhakamahi mā ā rātou pupuri tohu katoa.
steps.4: Ko te ripa Daily Spent e whakaatu ana ko wai te tino kaha ki te tohu i roto i ngā haora 24 kua hipa.
steps.5: Ko te Talk of the Town e whakaatu ana i ngā kaupapa/kātene tino matapaki.
steps.6: Pāwhiritia tētahi kaiwhakamahi ki te toro ki tōna kōtaha.
steps.7: Ka whakahouhia te papatohu i ngā wā puta noa i te rā.

tips.1: Ka hoki anō ngā whakarōrangitanga o ia rā ia 24 haora.
tips.2: Ko te Talk of the Town e whai ana i ngā kātene kotahi kupu mai i ngā hashtags.

command-centre.title: Pokapū Whakahau
command-centre.intro: He tirohanga papatohu e whakaatu ana i o inenga matua me te mahi papanga i te tirohanga kanohi.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te 'Command Centre' i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tirohia to whakarāpopototanga tauira, tae atu ki te maha o ngā whakairinga, ngā kaiwhai, me te uru.
steps.3: Tirohia to mahi tata nei me ngā kaupapa rongonui.
steps.4: Uru atu ki ngā hononga tere ki ngā āhuatanga e whakamahia nuitia ana.

tips.1: Ka hoatu e te Command Centre ki a koe he tirohanga mai i te rangi o to nohoanga DeHub.

governance.title: Kāwanatanga
governance.intro: Whai wāhi ki te kāwanatanga o te papanga mā te hanga tūtohutanga me te pōti i ngā whakatau a te hapori.

steps.1: Haere ki te 'Governance' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tirohia ngā tūtohutanga kaha i tukuna e te hapori.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia he tūtohutanga kia pānuihia tana whakaahuatanga katoa me te whakawhitiwhiti whakaaro.
steps.4: Pōtia ngā tūtohutanga mā te whakamahi i ngā patene matimati runga/raro — ka whakawhirinaki to taumaha pōti ki te maha o ngā tohu DeHub kua whakatakotoria e koe.
steps.5: Waiho he kōrero i runga i ngā tūtohutanga kia whakawhitiwhiti whakaaro ki te hapori.
steps.6: Tukuna to ake tūtohutanga mā te pāwhiri i te patene 'Create Proposal'.

tips.1: Ka whakatauhia to mana pōti e te maha o ngā tohu kua whakatakotoria e koe.
tips.2: Ka whiwhi pea ngā kaipupuri tohu i te taumaha pōti anō.
tips.3: Ka puta ngā tūtohutanga i ngā wāhanga: Kaha → Kua Pahemo/Kua Whakakorea.

bookmarks.title: Ngā Pukapuka
bookmarks.intro: Tiakina ngā whakairinga ki o pukapuka kia ngāwari te uru atu a muri ake nei.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te ata pukapuka i runga i tetahi whakairinga kia tiakina.
steps.2: Haere ki te 'Bookmarks' i te taha taha kia kitea katoatia ngā whakairinga kua tiakina.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia he whakairinga kua tohua hei pukapuka kia kitea katoatia.
steps.4: Tangohia he pukapuka mā te pāwhiri anō i te ata pukapuka.

tips.1: He muna ngā pukapuka — ko koe anake ka kite i o whakairinga kua tiakina.
tips.2: Kāore he rohe ki te maha o ngā whakairinga ka taea e koe te tohua hei pukapuka.

settings.title: Tautuhinga
settings.intro: Whakaritea to wheako DeHub mā te reo, te tūmataitinga, me ngā manakohanga whakaatu.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te 'Settings' i te taha taha.
steps.2: Hurihia to reo whakaatu mai i te kōwhiri reo.
steps.3: Whakarerekē ngā tautuhinga tūmataitinga: whakahaere ko wai ka kite i o tatauranga kaiwhai me te rarangi whai.
steps.4: Whakaritea ō tautuhinga matapōkere o ngā whakairinga.
steps.5: Whakahaerehia ngā tautuhinga whakamōhiotanga.

tips.1: Ka tautoko a DeHub i ngā reo maha — ka whakamaoritia te atanga katoa.
tips.2: Ka whai mana tonu ngā tautuhinga tūmataiti.

posting-allowance.title: Tō Āhuru Whakairinga o Ia Rā
posting-allowance.intro: He kore utu te whakairi ia rā tae noa ki tētahi rohe ka piki ake ki tō tohu takahi. Ka tīmata te katoa ki te tekau whakairinga kuputuhi me tētahi gigabyte o te ataata, ngā whakaahua me te oro ia rā. Haere ki tua atu i tētahi o ēnei, ka utua te toenga o taua rā ki ngā tohu DeHub — ko te wāhanga anake e pā ana.

steps.1: Whakairihia kia rite ki te tikanga. I roto i te rohe, kāore he utu, kāore hoki he tono ki a koe.
steps.2: He rerekē ngā puna whakairinga kuputuhi me ngā puna pāpāho, nā reira ko te rā e whakapau ana ki te tuku ataata ka waiho tonu kia tekau ngā whakairinga kuputuhi.
steps.3: Ka pā ana tētahi whakairinga ki tua atu, ka whakataua te taupānga i te tuatahi, ka tirotiro mena ka taea e tō putea te utu i mua i te tuku.
steps.4: Ka whakaputaina te whakairinga kia rite ki te mea i roto i te rohe — kāore te whakaputanga e tatari ki te utu.
steps.5: Ka whakaaetia e koe tētahi whakawhiti mo taua whakairinga anake, ka whakatauhia ki te Base, ki te BNB Chain rānei kei a ia ngā tohu DeHub.
steps.6: Ka tautetia ngā puna e rua i te waenganui pō UTC.

tips.1: Ko te nui ake he pro-rata: 200 MB i tua atu i tō rohe ka utu 200 MB, ehara i te gigabyte katoa.
tips.2: Ko ngā whakairinga anō, ngā kōrero, ngā tauhohenga, ngā tohutohu me ngā karere he kore utu, kāore hoki e pā ki te rohe.
tips.3: Whakaaetia te utu, ka noho tonu te whakairinga — ka aukati noa te nui i tō whakairinga utu e whai ake nei kia utua ra ano. Ko te rohe kore utu o āpōpō nau tonu.
tips.4: Ka piki ake te rohe kore utu o tētahi tohu takahi, ka whakaheke hoki i te utu o ngā mea i tua atu.

reactions-and-safety.title: Ngā Tauhohenga, Te Whakamutu me ngā Ihirangi Tūmatanui
reactions-and-safety.intro: E iwa ngā tauhohenga kei muri i te paatene pai, me tētahi huinga mana mo te whakatau i ngā mea ka kite koe me te hunga ka taea te whakapā atu ki a koe.

steps.1: Purihia te koromatua ki runga i tētahi whakairinga hei whakatuwhera i te paepae tauhohenga: pai, aroha, whakaute, wera, lol, pouri, tangi, kino, me te paru.
steps.2: Ko ngā whitu pai ka tatau ki te tapeke pai o te whakairinga; ko te kino me te paru ka tatau ki te taha ki raro.
steps.3: Ko tō tauhohenga ka taumaha e tō tohu takahi, nā reira ko te tauhohenga a te kaipupuri tohu ka nui ake te tatau i te kotahi pooti.
steps.4: Pāwhiritia te X i te pane o tētahi whakairinga hei whakamutu i tōna kaituhi — ka ngaro tonu ratou i tō whāngai.
steps.5: Ka tohuhia e ngā kaituhi a ratou ake whakairinga hei tūmatanui i te wa e hanga ana; ka noho tonu aua whakairinga ki waho o te whāngai kāinga.
steps.6: Hei kite i ngā whakairinga tūmatanui ki ngā wāhi katoa, whakauruhia te 'Whakaatu ihirangi tūmatanui' i roto i ngā Tautuhinga.

tips.1: He tino kitea tonu te whakairinga tūmatanui ki te pūkete a te kaituhi me te hunga e whai ana i a ratou.
tips.2: Ko te aukati mai i tētahi pūkete ka nui ake i te whakamutu, ka aukati hoki i te tuku karere.
tips.3: Ka whakaatu te paepae tauhohenga ko wai i tauhohe me te aha, nā reira ka kite koe i te ruma, kaua ko te nama anake.

stages.title: Ngā Wāhanga (Ngā Rūma Oro Ora)
stages.intro: Ko ngā Wāhanga he ruma oro ora i hangaia ki roto i a DeHub. Ka whakatuwherahia e tētahi kaihautū tētahi ruma, ka kawea ake ngā kaikorero, ā, ka taea e te tangata te tomo ki te whakarongo mai i te whārangi Wāhanga, i tētahi hononga kua tohaina rānei.

steps.1: Whakatuwherahia te 'Wāhanga' i te taha taha hei kite i ngā mea e ora ana inaianei me ngā mea kua whakaritea.
steps.2: Patia he atamira ora hei whakauru hei kaikōrero, ka whakarite rānei i tētahi whakamaharatanga ki tētahi kua whakaritea, ā, ka whakamōhiotia koe ina tīmata.
steps.3: Tīmata tō ake mai i te whārangi kotahi — ka taea e koe te haere ora tika mai i te pūtirotiro, kāore he OBS, kāore he kī kōrere.
steps.4: Hei kaihautū, kawea ngā kaikorero ki te atamira, whakawātea, whakakore rānei i a rātou, tohaina tō mata, ā, whakahaerehia te papa oro.
steps.5: Ka tukuna e ngā kaikōrero ngā tauhohe ora, ā, ka kōrero i roto i te kōrerorero ruma me te kore e tae ki te atamira.
steps.6: Ka tuhia ia atamira, ā, ka takaro anō te rekoata i muri mai i te kaari e puta ana.

tips.1: Ka tohua e ngā kupu hauraro ora ia kaikorero, ā, ka whakamaoritia ki ngā reo katoa e pānui ana koe.
tips.2: Ka taea e te reo irirangi ora te kōrero i te ruma ki te reo kōpeke o te kaihautū, ka utua ia meneti ki ngā tohu DeHub.
tips.3: Ka taea e ngā kaihautū te whakanoho i tētahi reo irirangi ki te rangi, te purei rānei i a rātou ake topenga waiata i waenga i ngā kōrero.
tips.4: Ka mau tonu te ruma ki te kaitākaro iti i te kokonga i a koe e tirotiro ana i te toenga o te taupānga.

communities.title: Ngā Hapori me ngā Takahanga
communities.intro: Ko ngā hapori he wāhi e whakahaeretia ana e ngā mema, me ā rātou ake kōrero, mema, me ngā mahi. Ka tāpiri ngā huihuinga i ngā kaupapa kua herea ki te wā ki runga ake i a rātou.

steps.1: Whakatuwheratia te 'Ngā Hapori' i te taha taha, ā, tirotirohia ngā hapori tūmatanui.
steps.2: Hono atu ki tētahi pā. Ka puta ngā mahi hou hei tohu kāore anō kia pānuitia i roto i te whakatere.
steps.3: Tukuna, matapaki, whakahaere pōtitanga, ā, hoatu moni ki roto i te kōrero a te hapori.
steps.4: Ka whakahaere ngā rangatira o te hapori i ā rātou ake wāhi, ā, ka taea e rātou te tuku mana whakahaere ki ētahi atu.
steps.5: Whakatuwheratia te 'Ngā Takahanga' mō ngā kaupapa kua whakaritea, me tētahi whārangi katoa mō ia huihuinga ka taea e koe te whai i te ora.

tips.1: Ka tautoko te kōrerorero a te hapori i ngā @whakapā me te @konei, nō reira ka taea e tētahi panui te tae ki te ruma.
tips.2: Ka taea e tētahi hononga powhiri te kawe tika i ngā tangata ki roto i tētahi hapori.

arcade.title: Arcade
arcade.intro: E rima ngā kēmu e rere ana i roto i te DeHub i roto i tētahi ripa pūtirotiro — kāore he mea hei whakauru, kāore he mea hei hoko.

steps.1: Whakatuwheratia te 'Arcade' i te taha taha.
steps.2: Kōwhiria tētahi kēmu: King's Gambit (chess 3D me tētahi arawhata Elo ipurangi), Claude of Duty (he kaikōkiri e whakaputa ana i āna ake toi i te wa e utaina ana), Jungle Trail (he hikoi ngāherehere ngāherehere), Street Slayer (he beat 'em up i hangaia mō DeHub) rānei Chartopia (he papa hokohoko ka taea te hikoi).
steps.3: Tākaro i te ripa. Ka mau a King's Gambit me Street Slayer i ngā papa kēmu.
steps.4: Ka rere anō a Chartopia i roto i tētahi pane VR mā WebXR.

tips.1: E rua o ēnei ka huna ki roto i ngā kaupapa ahua — whakaritea te taupānga ki te War mō Claude of Duty, ki te Jungle rānei mō Jungle Trail.
tips.2: He kaari tiritiri tō ia kēmu, nō reira ka tika te whakatuwhera o tētahi hono ki a ia ki hea koe e tuku ai.

bounties-stores.title: Ngā Pūtaonga me ngā Toa
bounties-stores.intro: E rua ngā huarahi hei huri i te papaa ki te moni: tukuna, kōwhiria rānei tētahi pūtaonga, whakatuwheratia rānei tētahi toa, ā, hokona atu ki tō hunga.

steps.1: Whakatuwheratia te 'Ngā Pūtaonga' hei tirotiro i ngā mahi tuwhera, kua tātarihia e te kātene, te moni rānei.
steps.2: Kōwhiria tētahi, mahia te mahi, ā, tukuna atu kia whiwhi ai i te utu — ka taea e te tangata katoa te kaikōkura, kāore he tono e hiahiatia.
steps.3: Tukua tō ake pōkai utu me tētahi kōrero poto me tētahi utu i roto i ngā tohu DeHub, USDC rānei. Ka noho ki te pūtea tiaki i te wā e tukua ana e koe.
steps.4: Whakatuwheratia te 'Toa' ki te whakarite i tētahi toa me tōna ake whārangi, tohu, me ngā rārangi.
steps.5: Ka whakatauhia ngā hua, ka utua ki ngā tohu DeHub mā te pēke i hangaia, kāore he pūnaha utu waho.

tips.1: Ka whakarōpūhia ngā pōkai utu ki roto i ngā Pāpāho Pāpori, Te Tapahi, me ngā Kirimana.
tips.2: Ka whakatauhia e tētahi pūnaha tautohetohe ngā rerekētanga mō te tuku, kia whakatauhia ai te pūtea tiaki kia tika tonu.
tips.3: Ka whakamahi ngā kaihanga i ngā pōkai utu ki te whakatipu i tētahi hapori — ko ngā hea, ngā tapahi, me ngā tauhohenga he mahi katoa.

creator-studio.title: Studio Kaihanga me te Etita
creator-studio.intro: Ka whakaputa te Studio Kaihanga i ngā whakaahua, ataata, waiata, reo, me ngā tauira 3D mai i tētahi akiaki, ā, ka tukuna ki tētahi etita — tae atu ki tētahi etita ataata maha-ara e rere ana i roto i te pūtirotiro.

steps.1: Whakatuwheratia te Studio Kaihanga ka whakaahuatia te mea e hiahia ana koe kia hangaia.
steps.2: Ka whakatauhia e te tūmau te utu i mua i te whakahaerenga o te mahi, kia kite koe i te utu i mua i te whakapau.
steps.3: Ka haere tonu ngā whakaahua ki roto i tētahi rarangi tūruhi i a koe e haereere ana i te taupānga.
steps.4: Whakaritea ngā hua ki roto i te etita momo Canva, ki te whakatuwhera rānei i te etita ataata mō tētahi wā tūturu me te tapahi, te whakatō, me te kaweake.
steps.5: Tukua te wāhanga kua oti ki roto tonu i tētahi pou, he poto, he rārangi toa rānei.

tips.1: He whare putunga taonga koreutu kei te taha o te Studio mō ngā mea katoa e pai ake ana koe kia kaua e whakaputa.
tips.2: Ka utua te whakaputanga ki ngā tohu DeHub mai i tō pēke — ka hainatia e koe tētahi whakawhiti mō ia mahi, ā, ka whakatauhia te utu i mua i te utu.
tips.3: Ka taea e ngā kaiwhakamahi taumaha te tango i tētahi mahere Ultra, Team, me Scale rānei, ka tukuna he taumata tohu ā-marama ki tō rātou pēke.

buying-dhb.title: Te Hoko Tohu
buying-dhb.intro: Hokona ngā tohu DeHub tika i roto i te taupānga mā te whakamahi i te atanga whakawhiti i hangaia.

steps.1: Haere ki te whārangi 'Hokona' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tīpakohia te tohu e hiahia ana koe ki te whakawhiti mai (hei tauira, ETH, USDC).
steps.3: Whakauruhia te nui e hiahia ana koe ki te whakapau, ki te maha rānei o ngā tohu e hiahia ana koe ki te whiwhi.
steps.4: Arotakehia te reiti whakawhiti me te hua kua tatauhia.
steps.5: Pāwhiritia te ata taputapu tautuhinga hei whakarereke i te manawanui o te reti (ko te taunoa ko te 1%).
steps.6: Whakaūngia te tauwhitinga whakawhiti.
steps.7: Ka puta ngā tohu DeHub ki tō pēke i te wā ka oti te tauwhitinga.

tips.1: Ko te manawanui o te reti teitei ake = ka nui ake te tupono ki te whakahaere, engari ka taea te utu kino ake.
tips.2: Tirohia tonu te reiti whakawhiti i mua i te whakaū.
tips.3: Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i te reti ritenga i roto i te panui tautuhinga.

bridge.title: Pūwhiti
bridge.intro: Nekehia ngā tohu DeHub i waenga i ngā poraka tautokona mā te whakamahi i te pūwhiti poraka-a-taha.

steps.1: Whāia te whārangi 'Bridge' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tīpakohia te mekameka pūtake (ko reira tō koutou tohu kei nāianei).
steps.3: Tīpakohia te mekameka ūnga (ko reira koutou e hiahia ana kia tukuna atu).
steps.4: Whakauruhia te maha o ngā tohu hei piriti.
steps.5: Arotakehia te utu piriti me te wā taenga tatari.
steps.6: Whakaūngia te tauwhitinga piriti.
steps.7: Mā te rōpū e tuku ngā tohu ki te mekameka taunga, i te nuinga o te wā i roto i ngā rā mahi 1-5.

tips.1: He rerekē ngā utu piriti mā te takirua mekameka.
tips.2: I tēnei wā, ka utua ā-ringa ngā utu piriti.
tips.3: Tirohia anō te mekameka ūnga i mua i te whakaūnga.

music-tv.title: Mūmū & Pouaka Whakaata
music-tv.intro: Kia pai ki ngā ihirangi pāpāho tika i roto i te DeHub — rerengia te waiata me te matakitaki i ngā pouaka whakaata ora.

steps.1: Whāia te 'Music' mai i te taha taha ki te rapu me te purei i ngā pou waiata.
steps.2: Whāia te 'TV' ki te uru atu ki ngā pouaka whakaata ora.
steps.3: Rapua ngā pouaka whakaata mā te kātene, mā te whenua rānei.
steps.4: Pāwhiritia tētahi pouaka whakaata ki te tīmata te matakitaki.
steps.5: Whakamahia ngā mana purei ki te whakatika i te oro me te purei anō.
steps.6: Pūrongohia ngā pouaka whakaata pakaru mā te whakamahi i te paatene pūrongo.

tips.1: Ko ngā pouaka whakaata ka whakamanahia e te hapori mō te pono.
tips.2: Ka taea te purei i ngā pou waiata i te wa e rapu ana i ētahi atu ihirangi.

post-info.title: Ngā Mōhiohio Pou & Wehenga
post-info.intro: Ko te pou i whakawhitia he NFT ka wehea ki te 1,000 wehenga. Ko te whārangi Mōhiohio Pou e whakaatu ana i ngā raraunga i runga mekameka, ngā tatauranga whakauru, te pakanga o te mana, me te tuku ki a koe ki te hokohoko i ngā wehenga o tētahi pou — i runga i tētahi pou kaore i whakawhitia ka tuku ki te whakawhiti hei utu.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te ata 'ⓘ' i runga i tētahi pou ki te whakatuwhera i tōna whārangi Mōhiohio Pou.
steps.2: Kei runga ka kite koe i te ID Tohu (tohu motuhake i runga mekameka) me te hash tauwhitinga — pāwhiritia te hash ki te tiro i runga i te kaitirotiro poraka.
steps.3: I raro iho i tēnā, ko ngā tatauranga whakauru e whakaatu ana i te tapeke o ngā pai, ngā kino, ngā tirohanga, ngā kōrero, me ngā tohu i whiwhia.
steps.4: Ko te wāhanga Kai-pupuri e whakaatu ana i tētahi pae-whakaeke o te maha o ngā 1,000 wehenga e pupuri tonu ana te kaihanga, me tētahi rārangi o ngā kaipupuri wehenga katoa me ō rātou toenga me ngā ōrau.
steps.5: Mēnā he utu-mō-te-titiro (PPV) te pou, ka kite koe i te utu, te moni, me te maha o ngā kaiwhakamahi kua hokona te uru.
steps.6: Ka taea e ngā kaipupuri pou te whakarerekē i te kitenga (Tūmatanui, Kaore i Rēhitatia, rānei Motuhake) me te whakatika i te taitara/whakaahuatanga tika mai i tēnei whārangi.

tips.1: Ka tīmata te pou hou i whakawhitia ki te kaihanga e pupuri ana i ngā 1,000 wehenga katoa (100% mana).
tips.2: Ko te hash tauwhitinga ka hono atu ki te BaseScan, ki te BscScan rānei i runga i te mekameka.
tips.3: Ngā pou kāore i te rārangi kaore e puta ki ngā pātaka engari ka taea tonu te toro atu mā te hononga tika.

buying-fractions.title: Te Hoko Wāhanga
buying-fractions.intro: Ka taea e koe te hoko wāhanga o tētahi pou kia whai mana koe ki tēnā ihirangi. Ko te hokohoko wāhanga ka puta ki te ripa hokohoko o te whārangi mōhiohio pou.

steps.1: Whakatūwheratia te whārangi mōhiohio pou mō te pou e aro ana koe (pāhia te ata 'ⓘ').
steps.2: Hurihia ki te ripa 'Hokohoko' kia kite i ngā rārangi me ngā tuku e wātea ana.
steps.3: Tirotirohia ngā wāhanga kua whakarārangihia — ka whakaatu ia rārangi i te kaihoko, te nui, te utu ia wāhanga, me te tapeke utu ki ngā tohu DeHub.
steps.4: Pāwhiritia 'Hanga Tuku' kia tukuna he tuku hoko i te utu e whiriwhiria e koe.
steps.5: Whakauruhia te maha o ngā wāhanga e hiahia ana koe me te utu ia wāhanga ki ngā tohu DeHub.
steps.6: Whakaūngia tō tuku — ka taea e te kaipupuri wāhanga te whakaae, te whakakore rānei.
steps.7: Ka whakaaetia, ka whakawhiti ngā wāhanga ki tō putea ka tukuna ngā tohu ki te kaihoko.

tips.1: Tirohia te rārangi kaipupuri kia kite i te tohatoha mana o nāianei i mua i te hoko.
tips.2: Ko te pupuri wāhanga o tētahi pou ko te tikanga kei a koe tētahi wāhanga o taua NFT i runga mekameka.
tips.3: Ko ngā utu wāhanga ka whakaritea e ngā kaihoko — rapua ngā tuku pai rawa atu.

selling-fractions.title: Te Hoko Wāhanga
selling-fractions.intro: Ki te pupuri koe i ngā wāhanga o tētahi pou (hei kaihanga, hei hoko mai rānei), ka taea e koe te whakarārangi hei hoko i runga i te maakete.

steps.1: Whakatūwheratia te whārangi mōhiohio pou mō tētahi pou e pupuri ana koe i ngā wāhanga.
steps.2: Hurihia ki te ripa 'Hokohoko'.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia te pātene 'Rārangi Wāhanga' (ka kitea anake mena kei a koe ngā wāhanga).
steps.4: Whakauruhia te maha o ngā wāhanga e hiahia ana koe ki te hoko.
steps.5: Tautuhia tō utu tono ia wāhanga ki ngā tohu DeHub.
steps.6: Arotakehia te uara tapeke o te rārangi ka whakaū.
steps.7: Kua whakarārangihia ō wāhanga — ka taea e ētahi atu kaiwhakamahi te hoko atu, te tuku atu rānei.

tips.1: Ka taea e koe te whakarārangi i tētahi nui tae atu ki tō pauna wāhanga katoa.
tips.2: Ka taea te whakakore i ngā rārangi i mua i te hokonga.
tips.3: Hei kaihanga, ko te hoko wāhanga ka taea e ngā kaiwhaiwhai te noho tahi ki tō ihirangi.

minting-posts.title: Te Whakaputa Pou (Te Hanga NFT)
minting-posts.intro: He kōwhiringa te whakaputa. Ka whakaputa te pou ki waho o te mekameka i te wā e tukuna ana e koe — karekau he putea, karekau he waitohu, karekau he hau — ā, ka taea e koe te whakaputa hei NFT i ngā wā katoa e hiahia ana koe, ahakoa i te wa e tuhi ana koe, i muri mai rānei mai i te pou ake.

steps.1: Pāwhiritia te pātene 'Pou' i te taha taha (papamahi) me te pātene + (waea pūkoro).
steps.2: Tuhia tō kuputuhi, āpiti ngā pāpāho (ngā whakaahua, ngā ataata, te oro), me te tāpiri kāwai.
steps.3: Waiho te 'Whakaputa pou' kia weto kia whakaputa ki waho o te mekameka, ki te kore rānei ka huri ki te whakaputa i te wa e whakaputa ana koe.
steps.4: Kāore te whakaputa i te tatari ki te mekameka: ka puta te pou ki te whangai ahakoa pēhea.
steps.5: Hei whakaputa i muri mai, whakatuwheratia te whārangi mōhiohio 'ⓘ' o te pou ka whakamahi i te mahi Whakaputa kei reira.
steps.6: Ka oti te whakaputa, ka whiwhi te pou i te ID Tohu me te hash tauwhitinga ka taea e koe te manatoko i runga i te mekameka, ā, kei a koe ngā 1,000 wāhanga katoa o taua mea.

tips.1: Ko ngā takiuru pāpori, īmēra, me SMS kaore he utu hau – ka tautoko a DeHub i ngā utu whakaputa.
tips.2: Ko ngā kaiwhakamahi putea o waho me whai ETH i runga i te Base, i te BNB rānei i runga i te BNB Chain mō te hau.
tips.3: Ko te whakaputa te mea ka taea ai te hokohoko me te kawe paanga o te pou. Ko te pou kaore i whakaputaina ka whiwhi tonu i ngā tohu me ngā tirohanga.
tips.4: Ko te rekoata i runga i te mekameka ka mau tonu ka oti te whakaputa, ahakoa ka mukua te pou i te whangai i muri mai.

glossary.title: Kupu Whakamārama
glossary.intro: He kohinga kupu matawhānui mō te crypto me te reo o te papanga hei āwhina i a koe ki te whakatere i te Web3.

steps.1: Haere ki te 'Kupu Whakamārama' mai i te taha taha.
steps.2: Tirohia ngā kupu kia whakarōpūhia, ka whakamahi rānei i te rapunga hei kimi kupu motuhake.
steps.3: Pāwhiritia tētahi kupu kia kite ai i tōna whakamārama katoa me tōna whakamaarama.
steps.4: Ko ngā kupu ka hipoki i ngā ariā crypto, te reo DeFi, me ngā āhuatanga motuhake o DeHub.

tips.1: He rauemi nui mō ngā tauhou ki te crypto me te Web3.
tips.2: Ka whakahoutia te kohinga kupu i ia wā ki ngā kupu hou.

dev.rankBody: I ia po ka whiwhi ia taupānga kua whakarārangitia i te tohu: 55% mai i nga kaiwhakamahi hoki (nga tangata i whakatuwherahia i tenei wiki me te wiki i mua), 35% mai i nga kaiwhakamahi wiki, me te 10% te kaha i roto i ona ra 14 tuatahi. Ko nga kaute DeHub anake i hainahia, na reira kaore he hua o nga bots me nga reload o te whaarangi.
dev.rewardsBody: Ia marama {{pool}} tohu ka tohaina i waenga i nga taupānga ma te tohu kotahi, ka tatauhia ia wiki. Hei tohu, e hiahia ana te taupānga ki te putea rangatira kua whakamanahia, me te iti rawa 3 kaiwhakamahi hoki. Ka utua e DeHub nga utu ki te putea rangatira.
dev.rewardsNone: Kaore ano kia whakaarohia he utu. Ka kati te wiki tuatahi i te Mane.

apk.seoTitle: Tangohia te APK DeHub — Te Putanga Android Hou Rawa
apk.seoDescription: Waiho ngā toa taupānga, tikina te putanga hou rawa o DeHub i konei tonu. He APK tika mō Android — he pūtake tuwhera, he pāpāho pāpori nā ngā kaiwhakamahi, kāore he pūkete toa e hiahiatia.
apk.ldDescription: Te taupānga Android DeHub hei APK ka tangohia tikatia. He pūtake tuwhera, he pāpāho pāpori nā ngā kaiwhakamahi — kāore he pūkete toa e hiahiatia.
apk.title: Waiho ngā toa.
apk.subtitle: Tikina te putanga hou rawa o DeHub i konei tonu — mai i a mātou tonu, kāore he pūkete toa, kāore he tatari mō te arotake.
apk.installHint: Whakaaetia ngā tāutanga mai i tō pūtirotiro ina pātai a Android. Kei te whakahou? Tāutahia ki runga i tō taupānga o nāianei, kaua e wetewete.
apk.useInBrowser: Whakamahia a DeHub i tō pūtirotiro
apk.googlePlay: He pai ake ki a koe a Google Play? Tikina i reira.
apk.shareText: Waiho ngā toa — tikina tikatia te putanga Android hou rawa o DeHub.

walletBackup.phraseUnavailable: Ko te kupu whakaora kaore i te waatea mai i tenei tohu. Whakamahia tō takiuru taketake, tō pūrere rānei hei tirotiro. Ka taea tonu e koe te tautoko i to koutou kī tūmataiti.
walletBackup.phraseMismatch: Ko tēnei tārua e hāngai ana ki tētahi atu putea. Hokona tō takiuru taketake ki te uru atu ki te tārua tika.
walletBackup.backupDescription: Tiakina tō kī whakaora, kī tūmataiti rānei kia taea ai e koe te whakahoki mai i tō putea.
walletBackup.phraseOtherDevice: Tirohia DeHub ki te rōpū wāhanga e tuwhera i te wā kua whakaputaina tēnei pūtea, kia kitea te kupu whakapaukata. Ka taea hoki e koe whakapaukata tō tātou pukenga pāpāherekore ki konei.
walletBackup.phraseLoadFailed: Kaore e taea e au te whakahoki mai i to korero. Hoki ki te tirotiro i te reira, ranei whakatuwhera DeHub i runga i tou pūrere taketake.
walletBackup.noPhrase: I ora tenei putea ma te whakamahi i te kī tūmataiti, na DeHub kaore he kupu whakaora hei whakaatu. Whakahokia tenei kī ki te whakahoki i te putea kotahi.
walletBackup.keyWarning: Ko te tangata e whai ana i tenei kī ka taea te whakahaere i to putea. Tiaki i te reira i tetahi wahi haumaru, a kahore e faaite i te reira.
walletBackup.introTitle: Ka taea e koe te whakahoki mai i to putea?
walletBackup.introBody: 12 kupu e whakahoki mai i to putea ki te ngaro koe i to waea, i to kupuhipa ranei. E 30 hēkona te roa.
walletBackup.checkWrong: Ehara i te mea. Tirohia o koutou kupu, me te tamata ano.
walletBackup.warnOwns: Ko te tangata e whai ana i enei kupu, e whai ana i to putea.
walletBackup.warnNeverAsk: Kaore a DeHub e ui ki a raatau.
walletBackup.warnPaper: Tuhia ki te pepa, kaua ki te pikitia, ki te taupānga pūkete ranei.
walletBackup.copied: Tārua. Clipboard horoi i roto i te 30s
